en.omega-ruby: Inside Shelgon’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
en.alpha-sapphire: Covering Shelgon’s body are outgrowths much like bones. The shell is very hard and bounces off enemy attacks. When awaiting evolution, this Pokémon hides away in a cavern.
en.sun: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.
en.moon: They lurk deep within caves—motionless, neither eating nor drinking. Why they don’t die is not known.
en.ultra-sun: The cells within its body are changing at a bewildering pace. Its hard shell is made from the same substance as bone.
en.ultra-moon: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.
en.sword: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.
en.shield: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

es.x: Las células han empezado a cambiar dentro de su dura concha, que se separa cuando evoluciona.
es.y: La robusta capa que lo rodea repele los ataques. Aunque es una buena protección, lo hace lento y pesado.
es.omega-ruby: Dentro de la capa acorazada de Shelgon, las células están en pleno proceso de creación de un cuerpo nuevo. El peso de la coraza le hace tener unos movimientos lentos.
es.alpha-sapphire: Shelgon está recubierto por una especie de capa ósea: una coraza muy dura que hace rebotar los ataques enemigos. Este Pokémon se esconde en las cavernas para evolucionar.
es.sun: En el interior de su coraza, las células se transforman a una velocidad vertiginosa para preparar su evolución.
es.moon: Permanece quieto en el fondo de las grutas sin probar bocado ni beber ningún líquido. Resulta sorprendente que pueda sobrevivir así.
es.ultra-sun: Las células de su cuerpo se transforman a una velocidad vertiginosa. Su dura coraza está formada por una especie de tejido óseo.
es.ultra-moon: Vive en el fondo de las grutas. Mientras se recluye en su dura concha, sueña con el día en el que pueda surcar el cielo volando.
es.sword: Lo recubre una dura coraza de tejido óseo. En el interior, acumula energía de cara a la evolución.
es.shield: Aguanta el hambre sin comer nada. Al parecer, inicia el proceso evolutivo cuando se agota toda la energía que tenía acumulada.

en.ruby: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
en.sapphire: By evolving into SALAMENCE, this POKéMON finally realizes its long-held dream of growing wings. To express its joy, it flies and wheels all over the sky while spouting flames from its mouth.
en.emerald: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.
en.firered: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
en.leafgreen: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
en.diamond: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
en.pearl: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
en.platinum: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
en.heartgold: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.
en.soulsilver: It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.
en.black: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

en.omega-ruby: Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
en.alpha-sapphire: By evolving into Salamence, this Pokémon finally realizes its long-held dream of growing wings. To express its joy, it flies and wheels all over the sky while spouting flames from its mouth.
en.sun: When angered, it loses all sense of itself and destroys everything around it. The destruction will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.
en.moon: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.
en.ultra-sun: Overjoyed at finally being able to fly, it flies all over the place and usually doesn’t land until it’s completely exhausted and needs to sleep.
en.ultra-moon: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart’s desire—wings.
en.sword: Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.
en.shield: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

es.x: Si se enfada, no hay forma de calmarlo; lo destruye todo lanzando arañazos y llamas.
es.y: Si se enfada, no hay forma de que se calme. Echa a volar e incendia campos y montañas desde el cielo.
es.omega-ruby: Salamence surgió del profundo deseo de tener alas. Dicen que este fuerte deseo fue lo que causó la repentina mutación de las células y el crecimiento de las alas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Al evolucionar Shelgon y convertirse por fin en Salamence, ve cumplido el sueño de su vida de tener alas. Para expresar su alegría, Salamence vuela y revolotea por el cielo al tiempo que lanza llamas por la boca.
es.sun: Cuando se enfada, pierde el control y destruye todo lo que está a su alcance. Solo se calma cuando se queda sin fuerzas.
es.moon: Feliz de haber desarrollado al fin sus alas y de poder volar por el cielo, calcina con sus llamas todos los campos que sobrevuela.
es.ultra-sun: Ahora que por fin puede volar, surca los cielos con una sonrisa en el rostro. No pisa tierra firme a no ser que tenga que dormir o esté exhausto.
es.ultra-moon: Su fuerte y firme deseo de volar provocó una mutación repentina de su estructura celular que le permitió obtener las alas que tanto ansiaba.
es.sword: Un Pokémon poco común que, tras desear con todas sus fuerzas poder volar, consiguió un cuerpo alado al evolucionar.
es.shield: Feliz de ver cumplido su deseo, surca los cielos con buen ánimo, pero, si se enfada, se vuelve violento e incontrolable.

en.platinum: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
en.ruby: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
en.sapphire: BELDUM keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth’s natural magnetism. When it sleeps, this POKéMON anchors itself to a cliff using the hooks on its rear.
en.emerald: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one POKéMON. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
en.firered: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
en.leafgreen: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
en.diamond: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
en.pearl: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
en.heartgold: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.
en.soulsilver: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

en.omega-ruby: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout Beldum’s body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
en.alpha-sapphire: Beldum keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth’s natural magnetism. When it sleeps, this Pokémon anchors itself to a cliff using the hooks on its rear.
en.sun: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.
en.moon: With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in close. When they’re in range, it slashes them with its rear claws.
en.ultra-sun: Instead of blood, magnetism flows through its body. When it’s feeling bad, try giving it a magnet.
en.ultra-moon: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.
en.sword: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.
en.shield: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

es.x: Los pulsos magnéticos de su cuerpo repelen la gravedad, lo que le permite flotar en el aire.
es.y: Se comunican mediante pulsos magnéticos. Cuando van en grupos, se mueven al unísono.
es.omega-ruby: En lugar de sangre, Beldum tiene una poderosa fuerza magnética corriéndole por las venas. Este Pokémon se comunica enviando controlados impulsos magnéticos.
es.alpha-sapphire: Beldum se mantiene flotando en el aire gracias a la fuerza magnética que genera y que repele la gravedad. Para dormir, este Pokémon se ancla a los riscos usando los ganchos que tiene.
es.sun: Todas las células de su cuerpo son imanes. Se comunica con los suyos mediante magnetismo.
es.moon: Atrae a sus rivales con el magnetismo que emite, y, cuando están cerca, los despedaza con las garras que tiene en la parte trasera.
es.ultra-sun: En vez de torrente sanguíneo, el cuerpo de este Pokémon cuenta con corrientes magnéticas. Es recomendable darle un imán si se encuentra mal.
es.ultra-moon: Cuando se le provoca, no solo monta en cólera, sino que emite también un potente magnetismo que inutiliza ciertos tipos de máquinas.
es.sword: Atrae con fuerza a sus enemigos debido al magnetismo que emite por la parte trasera y les clava sus afilados ganchos.
es.shield: Las células de su cuerpo están hechas de imanes. En lugar de sangre, una fuerza magnética recorre su cuerpo.

en.ruby: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
en.sapphire: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This POKéMON turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.
en.emerald: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.
en.firered: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.
en.leafgreen: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.
en.diamond: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
en.pearl: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
en.platinum: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
en.heartgold: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
en.soulsilver: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
en.black: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
en.white: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
en.black-2: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.
en.white-2: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

en.omega-ruby: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.
en.alpha-sapphire: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This Pokémon turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.
en.sun: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.
en.moon: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.
en.ultra-sun: With its two brains, it fires powerful psychic energy to stop its prey in their tracks.
en.ultra-moon: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.
en.sword: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
en.shield: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

es.x: Lo forman dos Beldum unidos. Puede chocarse con un avión sin que su cuerpo de acero sufra ni un rasguño.
es.y: Está formado por dos Beldum unidos. Tiene dos cerebros, así que cuenta con poderes psíquicos amplificados.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando dos Beldum se fusionan, forman un Metang. Los cerebros de los Beldum se unen mediante un sistema nervioso magnético y generan potente energía psicoquinética.
es.alpha-sapphire: Cuando se funden dos Beldum, uniendo los cerebros por un sistema nervioso magnético, se forma un Metang. Para desplazarse a mayor velocidad, este Pokémon echa los brazos hacia atrás.
es.sun: Al unirse dos Beldum, sus poderes psíquicos se duplican. No obstante, su inteligencia no se ve afectada.
es.moon: Le encanta comer minerales con propiedades magnéticas. Puede rastrear a un Nosepass desplazándose a más de 100 km/h.
es.ultra-sun: El poder psíquico combinado de ambos cerebros es tal que le permite paralizar a sus presas.
es.ultra-moon: Surca el cielo a gran velocidad. En cuanto avista su presa, la agarra con sus afiladas garras y ya no se desprende de ella.
es.sword: Está formado por la fusión magnética de dos Beldum. Al tener dos cerebros, sus poderes psíquicos se ven duplicados.
es.shield: Levita gracias al magnetismo. Es capaz de sortear escarpadas montañas mientras vuela a altas velocidades en pos de su presa.

en.ruby: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
en.sapphire: METAGROSS is the result of two METANG achieving fusion. When hunting, this POKéMON pins the prey to the ground under its massive body. It then eats the helpless victim using the large mouth on its stomach.
en.emerald: METAGROSS has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this POKéMON is smarter than a supercomputer.
en.firered: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
en.leafgreen: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
en.diamond: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
en.pearl: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
en.platinum: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
en.heartgold: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
en.soulsilver: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.
en.black: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
en.white: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
en.black-2: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
en.white-2: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
en.x: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.
en.y: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
en.omega-ruby: Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
en.ultra-moon: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.
en.alpha-sapphire: Metagross is the result of two Metang achieving fusion. When hunting, this Pokémon pins the prey to the ground under its massive body. It then eats the helpless victim using the large mouth on its stomach.
en.sun: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.
en.moon: A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing parallel processing in its four brains.
en.ultra-sun: It boasts not only psychic powers but also fantastic strength. It grabs its prey with its four legs and holds them in place with its claws.
en.sword: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.
en.shield: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

es.x: Gracias a sus cuatro cerebros, es más inteligente que un superordenador y analiza con precisión al enemigo.
es.y: Está formado por varios Metang. Con cuatro cerebros, tiene la inteligencia de un superordenador.
es.omega-ruby: Metagross tiene cuatro cerebros en total que, combinados, son capaces de resolver cálculos complicados más rápido que el mejor ordenador que haya. Metagross puede flotar en el aire si mete las patas hacia adentro.
es.alpha-sapphire: Metagross es el resultado de la fusión de dos Metang. Cuando caza, acorrala a su presa, sujetándola contra el suelo con el cuerpo. Después, devora a la víctima indefensa con la gran boca del estómago.
es.sun: Con sus cuatro garras y su descomunal cuerpo aprisiona a sus presas para luego devorarlas con sus dientes.
es.moon: Metagross es el resultado de la fusión de dos Metang. Con sus cuatro cerebros funcionando en paralelo realiza cualquier cálculo al instante.
es.ultra-sun: Se enorgullece tanto de su poder psíquico como de su gran fuerza. Agarra a sus presas con las cuatro extremidades metálicas y las inmoviliza.
es.ultra-moon: Analiza al enemigo con más precisión incluso que un superordenador y, sin inmutarse, lo pone contra las cuerdas.
es.sword: Su fuerza magnética se potencia en temperaturas bajo cero, por lo que los Metagross que habitan en montañas nevadas son especialmente vivaces.
es.shield: Formado a partir de la unión de dos Metang. Emplea su inteligencia, comparable a la de un superordenador, para derrotar a sus rivales.

en.ruby: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
en.sapphire: REGIROCK’s body is composed entirely of rocks. Recently, a study made the startling discovery that the rocks were all unearthed from different locations.
en.emerald: A POKéMON that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by adding new rocks.
en.firered: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
en.leafgreen: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
en.diamond: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
en.pearl: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
en.platinum: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
en.heartgold: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.
en.soulsilver: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

es.y: Al parecer, hace mucho tiempo tenía una gran concha protectora. Vive en aguas poco profundas.
es.omega-ruby: Si se ve amenazado por sus enemigos naturales, segrega un líquido morado y huye rápidamente.
es.alpha-sapphire: Al parecer, hace mucho tiempo tenía una gran concha protectora. Vive en aguas poco profundas.
es.sun: Posee una notable capacidad de regeneración. Aunque los Pokémon pez lo mordisqueen, puede recuperarse en tan solo unas pocas horas.
es.moon: Su principal alimento es plancton invisible. Sale a la superficie, pero aún se desconoce el motivo.
es.ultra-sun: Un caparazón le cubría la espalda antaño, y el único indicio de este hecho es la fina y dura placa en la capa interna del lomo.
es.ultra-moon: Altera tanto la forma como el color en función de su hábitat y el alimento del que se nutre. Abunda en las playas de calmo oleaje.
es.sword: Puede desplazarse también por tierra firme en pos de su presa. Deja tras de sí, entonces, el rastro de una mucosidad pegajosa.
es.shield: Aunque blando, su cuerpo es tremendamente resistente, ya que dispersa cualquier impacto que recibe dada su flexibilidad.

en.pearl: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
en.platinum: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.
en.heartgold: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.
en.soulsilver: It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.

en.ultra-moon: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.
en.legends-arceus: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

es.x: Habitan en grandes colonias y forman anillos uniendo sus colas, aparentemente en signo de amistad.
es.y: Para comer, rompe nueces con sus dos colas. Raras veces utiliza sus brazos.
es.omega-ruby: Habitan en grandes colonias y forman anillos uniendo sus colas, aparentemente en signo de amistad.
es.alpha-sapphire: Para comer, rompe nueces con sus dos colas. Raras veces utiliza sus brazos.
es.ultra-sun: Su especie arma constantes trifulcas por los árboles más cómodos con los Passimian. Suelen ganar la mitad de las veces.
es.ultra-moon: Utiliza las dos colas para todo. Cuando abraza a alguien con ellas significa que esa persona se ha ganado por completo su confianza.

en.diamond: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
en.pearl: It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.
en.platinum: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
en.heartgold: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.
en.soulsilver: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

en.white: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”

en.moon: If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills out with a screaming sound.
en.ultra-sun: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.
en.ultra-moon: Wandering souls gathered together to form this Pokémon. When trying to make friends with children, Drifloon grabs them by the hand.
en.sword: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.
en.shield: The gathering of many souls gave rise to this Pokémon. During humid seasons, they seem to appear in abundance.
en.legends-arceus: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

es.x: Está formado por los espíritus de personas y Pokémon. Le encantan las estaciones húmedas.
es.y: Se dice que es como un hito que guía a las almas. Los niños que sostienen un Drifloon a veces desaparecen sin más.
es.omega-ruby: Está formado por los espíritus de personas y Pokémon. Le encantan las estaciones húmedas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Se dice que es como un hito que guía a las almas. Los niños que sostienen un Drifloon a veces desaparecen sin más.
es.sun: Se dice que coge a niños pequeños de la mano y se los lleva al otro mundo. Prefiere a los niños que no pesan mucho.
es.moon: Si por alguna razón su cuerpo llega a reventar, emite un sonido parecido al de un grito al tiempo que se escapa su energía vital.
es.ultra-sun: En el interior de su cuerpo redondo almacena gran número de almas. Aumenta de tamaño con cada persona que se lleva.
es.ultra-moon: Está formado por espíritus errantes que vagan por los caminos. Se lleva a los niños de la mano para entablar amistad con ellos.
es.sword: Se acerca a los niños en busca de compañía, pero lo tratan como un juguete y a menudo tiene que salir huyendo.
es.shield: Está formado por una aglomeración de espíritus. Suele aparecer en grandes números durante las estaciones húmedas.

en.diamond: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
en.pearl: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
en.platinum: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
en.heartgold: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
en.soulsilver: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
en.black: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
en.white: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
en.black-2: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.

en.moon: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.
en.ultra-sun: There’s a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you’ll be carried away to the afterlife.
en.ultra-moon: The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it’s thought to carry away people and Pokémon.
en.sword: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
en.shield: It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them off somewhere. Where do they go? Nobody knows.
en.legends-arceus: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

es.x: Transporta a gente y a Pokémon volando, pero, como se deja llevar, puede acabar en cualquier sitio.
es.y: Durante el día está somnoliento, pero por la noche sale volando en grupo, aunque nadie sabe adónde.
es.omega-ruby: Transporta a gente y a Pokémon volando, pero, como se deja llevar, puede acabar en cualquier sitio.
es.alpha-sapphire: Durante el día está somnoliento, pero por la noche sale volando en grupo, aunque nadie sabe adónde.
es.sun: Hubo un caso de un chico que se subió a un Drifblim y salió de viaje. Desde entonces está en paradero desconocido.
es.moon: Al anochecer, se reúnen en grupos y vuelan a la deriva. Si alguien trata de seguirlos con la mirada, desaparecen al instante.
es.ultra-sun: Se rumorea que los Drifblim que surcan el cielo al ocaso llevan a todos aquellos que atrapan al más allá.
es.ultra-moon: El gas que alberga su interior se compone de almas. Si su cuerpo se deshincha, arrastra consigo tanto a personas como a Pokémon.
es.sword: Se dice que está formado por almas en pena. Al caer la noche, flota a la deriva en silencio sepulcral.
es.shield: Agarra a gente y a Pokémon para llevárselos a algún sitio, aunque nadie sabe exactamente adónde.

en.diamond: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
en.pearl: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.
en.platinum: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
en.heartgold: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.
en.soulsilver: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.

en.ultra-moon: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it’s attacked by an enemy.
en.sword: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.
en.shield: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.
en.legends-arceus: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

es.x: Lleva las orejas enrolladas. Cuando las extiende, golpea con tal fuerza que incluso puede romper rocas.
es.y: Cuando siente peligro, levanta las orejas. En noches frías, duerme con la cabeza metida en el pelaje.
es.omega-ruby: Lleva las orejas enrolladas. Cuando las extiende, golpea con tal fuerza que incluso puede romper rocas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Cuando siente peligro, levanta las orejas. En noches frías, duerme con la cabeza metida en el pelaje.
es.ultra-sun: Si bien sus extremidades pecan de débiles, si enrolla las orejas y luego las extiende, puede hacer añicos incluso rocas bien grandes.
es.ultra-moon: Siempre tiene una de las orejas enrollada para poder contraatacar de inmediato si un enemigo lanza su ofensiva.
es.sword: Cuando enrolla ambas orejas, es señal de que tiene algún tipo de malestar físico o emocional y necesita cuidados.
es.shield: Ataca estirando con un fuerte impulso las orejas enrolladas. Cuanto más entrena esta técnica, con más potencia la ejecuta.

en.platinum: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
en.heartgold: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

en.ultra-sun: Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.
en.ultra-moon: It’s notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.
en.sword: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.
en.shield: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.
en.legends-arceus: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

es.x: Este Pokémon resulta muy precavido. Si siente peligro, escapa corriendo a grandes saltos.
es.y: Sus orejas son muy delicadas. Si alguien las toca con brusquedad, recibirá una espléndida patada.

es.ultra-sun: Muda el pelo dos veces al año. Este se usa en la confección de unos gorros y bufandas que abrigan mucho.
es.ultra-moon: Es cauteloso y nada amante de los combates, pero puede propinar potentes patadas si la situación lo requiere.
es.sword: Está siempre atento a lo que ocurre a su alrededor. Si advierte peligro, se defenderá con patadas de potencia devastadora.
es.shield: Cuando acaba la estación más tórrida, le crece un nuevo pelaje muy mullido que lo prepara para el frío.

es.y: Atormenta a sus rivales con gritos que parecen conjuros. Aparece en ocasiones y lugares imprevistos.

es.moon: Es capaz de lanzar hechizos y conjuros de amor, por lo que hay gente totalmente obsesionada con encontrar a un Mismagius.

es.ultra-moon: Murmura conjuros para atormentar al enemigo y provocarle dolores de cabeza insoportables o visiones terroríficas.

en.pearl: It makes its MURKROW cronies bring it food. It idles its time away, grooming itself in its nest.

es.y: Está activo por la noche y pulula arrastrando a numerosos Murkrow.

es.sun: Es un Pokémon nocturno. Con un solo grito puede hacer que acudan más de cien de sus leales Murkrow.
es.moon: Si alguno de sus leales Murkrow fracasa en conseguirle una presa o se la guarda para sí, lo perseguirá sin descanso para castigarle.
es.ultra-sun: No perdona el más mínimo error ni la traición de sus subordinados. Este estricto código es para preservar la integridad de su bandada.
es.ultra-moon: Delega el combate en sus leales súbditos y solo se involucra cuando llega la hora de asestarle el golpe de gracia al enemigo.

es.shield: Siempre está soñando o adormecido. Se pone de muy mal humor al despertar, por lo que es mejor no perturbarlo.

es.shield: Se dirige hacia cualquier sonido que perciba. Es ligeramente cálido al tacto, debido al efecto de su núcleo energético.

en.shield: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

es.moon: Busca lagos subterráneos en las cuevas. Como le cuesta asimilar el agua, tiene que beber lentamente a base de lametones.
es.ultra-sun: La energía que desprende de su cuerpo termina por solidificarse en cristales anaranjados, tan duros que pueden quebrar hasta los diamantes.
es.ultra-moon: Los cristales naranjas de su cuerpo son energía condensada. El valor que poseen es tal que lo convierten en un Pokémon muy codiciado.
es.sword: Cuando sus cristales anaranjados comienzan a brillar, conviene tener cuidado, pues es señal de que está a punto de liberar energía.
es.shield: Se vale del sonido para percibir el entorno. Si alguien despierta su ira, lo perseguirá sin cambiar la orientación del cuerpo.

en.black: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
en.white: The solar energy absorbed by its body’s orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.
en.black-2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
en.white-2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
en.x: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
en.y: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
en.omega-ruby: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
en.alpha-sapphire: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
en.sun: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.
en.moon: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.
en.ultra-sun: When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.
en.ultra-moon: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It’s usually lurking deep beneath the surface.
en.sword: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.
en.shield: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

es.x: Absorbe los rayos solares, procesa esa energía en su núcleo y lanza poderosas bolas de luz a sus enemigos.
es.y: El núcleo de su cuerpo comprime la energía para lanzar ataques capaces de destruir una montaña.
es.omega-ruby: Absorbe los rayos solares, procesa esa energía en su núcleo y lanza poderosas bolas de luz a sus enemigos.
es.alpha-sapphire: El núcleo de su cuerpo comprime la energía para lanzar ataques capaces de destruir una montaña.
es.sun: Absorbe los rayos solares y los transforma en poderosas bolas de energía. Sin embargo, no puede hacerlo de noche o en días lluviosos.
es.moon: La soberbia potencia de la que hace gala lo convierte en un ayudante idóneo para todo trabajador de la construcción.
es.ultra-sun: Cuando dispara energía con todas sus fuerzas, la potencia es tal que le provoca incontables fisuras por todo el cuerpo.
es.ultra-moon: Absorbe los rayos de sol y los expulsa en forma de energía. Suele ocultarse en las profundidades subterráneas.
es.sword: Su robustez le permite colaborar con humanos y Copperajah en labores de construcción y minería.
es.shield: Las bolas de energía que lanza solo en días soleados son tan potentes que pueden hacer saltar un camión por los aires.

en.black: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
en.white: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
en.black-2: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
en.white-2: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
en.x: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
en.y: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
en.omega-ruby: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
en.alpha-sapphire: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
en.sword: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.
en.shield: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

es.x: Vive en bosques oscuros y cavernas. Emite ultrasonidos por la nariz para saber todo lo que pasa a su alrededor.
es.y: Se dice que la marca con forma de corazón que deja un Woobat al incrustar su nariz trae buena suerte.
es.omega-ruby: Vive en bosques oscuros y cavernas. Emite ultrasonidos por la nariz para saber todo lo que pasa a su alrededor.
es.alpha-sapphire: Se dice que la marca con forma de corazón que deja un Woobat al incrustar su nariz trae buena suerte.
es.sword: Si al alzar la vista en una cueva se ven marcas con forma de corazón en las paredes, es señal de que Woobat la ha convertido en su guarida.
es.shield: Emite ultrasonidos mientras revolotea en busca de los Pokémon insecto con los que se sustenta.

en.black: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
en.white: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
en.black-2: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
en.white-2: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
en.x: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
en.y: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
en.omega-ruby: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
en.alpha-sapphire: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
en.sword: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.
en.shield: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

es.x: Cuando emite ondas ultrasónicas, que incluso pueden reventar el cemento, agita su cola con vehemencia.
es.y: Todos rebosan de alborozo cuando perciben las ondas ultrasónicas emitidas por el macho para cortejar a la hembra.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando emite ondas ultrasónicas, que incluso pueden reventar el cemento, agita su cola con vehemencia.
es.alpha-sapphire: Todos rebosan de alborozo cuando perciben las ondas ultrasónicas emitidas por el macho para cortejar a la hembra.
es.sword: Tras emitir sus potentísimas ondas, queda tan exhausto que es incapaz de volar durante un tiempo.
es.shield: En algunas regiones se venera a este Pokémon, ya que consideran la forma de su nariz como un símbolo de felicidad.

en.black: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
en.white: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
en.black-2: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
en.white-2: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
en.x: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
en.y: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
en.omega-ruby: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
en.alpha-sapphire: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
en.sword: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.
en.shield: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

es.x: Cuando junta las garras y comienza a dar vueltas frenéticas, avanza bajo tierra a gran velocidad.
es.y: Puede girar su cuerpo a una velocidad de 50 km/h y, si la mantiene, puede perforar el suelo y atravesarlo.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando junta las garras y comienza a dar vueltas frenéticas, avanza bajo tierra a gran velocidad.
es.alpha-sapphire: Puede girar su cuerpo a una velocidad de 50 km/h y, si la mantiene, puede perforar el suelo y atravesarlo.
es.sword: Tras juntar las garras, se abalanza sobre su presa haciendo rotar el cuerpo a gran velocidad.
es.shield: Su costumbre de horadar túneles bajo tierra le ha granjeado la antipatía de los agricultores, ya que puede echar a perder cosechas enteras.

en.black: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
en.white: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
en.black-2: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.
en.white-2: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.
en.x: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
en.y: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
en.omega-ruby: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
en.alpha-sapphire: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
en.sword: It’s not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill’s rampant digging.
en.shield: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

es.x: Su taladro ha evolucionado y es capaz de atravesar una lámina de hierro. Es muy útil para construir túneles.
es.y: Construye madrigueras laberínticas a 100 m bajo tierra. A veces abre agujeros en los túneles de metro.
es.omega-ruby: Su taladro ha evolucionado y es capaz de atravesar una lámina de hierro. Es muy útil para construir túneles.
es.alpha-sapphire: Construye madrigueras laberínticas a 100 m bajo tierra. A veces abre agujeros en los túneles de metro.
es.sword: Se dice que muchas grutas que parecen naturales han sido en realidad horadadas por los Excadrill.
es.shield: Se lo conoce como el Rey del Taladro. Puede horadar túneles bajo tierra a una velocidad de 150 km/h.

en.black: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
en.white: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.
en.black-2: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
en.white-2: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
en.x: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
en.y: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
en.omega-ruby: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
en.alpha-sapphire: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
en.sword: Audino’s sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino’s ears.
en.shield: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

es.x: Con las antenas de sus oídos, perciben el estado de un rival o predicen cuándo va a eclosionar un Huevo Pokémon.
es.y: Al tocar a alguien con las antenas de sus orejas, conoce su estado de ánimo y de salud por los latidos del corazón.
es.omega-ruby: Con las antenas de sus oídos, perciben el estado de un rival o predicen cuándo va a eclosionar un Huevo Pokémon.
es.alpha-sapphire: Al tocar a alguien con las antenas de sus orejas, conoce su estado de ánimo y de salud por los latidos del corazón.
es.sword: Su sentido del oído es extraordinario. Puede percibir el sonido de una piedrecita rodando a 2 km de distancia.
es.shield: Un Pokémon gentil que es capaz de comprender los sentimientos y averiguar el estado de salud de todo aquel que toque con sus antenas.

en.black: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
en.white: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
en.black-2: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
en.white-2: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
en.x: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
en.y: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
en.omega-ruby: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.
en.alpha-sapphire: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
en.sword: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.
en.shield: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

es.x: Siempre lleva vigas de madera. Normalmente ayuda en obras de construcción.
es.y: Siempre lleva una viga de madera y ayuda en las construcciones. Se busca una viga más grande cuando se hace más fuerte.
es.omega-ruby: Siempre lleva vigas de madera. Normalmente ayuda en obras de construcción.
es.alpha-sapphire: Siempre lleva una viga de madera y ayuda en las construcciones. Se busca una viga más grande cuando se hace más fuerte.
es.sword: Le gusta ayudar en labores de construcción. Cuando la lluvia obliga a interrumpir las obras, blande con furia su viga de madera.
es.shield: Cuando logra transportar una viga de madera que triplica su altura y peso, es señal de que va a evolucionar.

en.black: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
en.white: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.
en.black-2: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
en.white-2: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
en.x: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
en.y: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
en.omega-ruby: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
en.alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
en.sword: It shows off its muscles to Machoke and other Gurdurr. If it fails to measure up to the other Pokémon, it lies low for a little while.
en.shield: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

es.x: Gracias a su entrenada musculatura, puede blandir vigas de acero sin problema para así derribar edificios enteros.
es.y: Sus músculos están tan desarrollados que no se inmuta aunque lo ataquen varios luchadores.
es.omega-ruby: Gracias a su entrenada musculatura, puede blandir vigas de acero sin problema para así derribar edificios enteros.
es.alpha-sapphire: Sus músculos están tan desarrollados que no se inmuta aunque lo ataquen varios luchadores.
es.sword: A menudo realiza competiciones de fuerza con sus congéneres y con los Machoke. El perdedor debe pasar un tiempo sin dejarse ver.
es.shield: Blande vigas de acero con gran destreza, pero la construcción no se le da muy bien; de hecho, su especialidad es la demolición.

en.black: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
en.white: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.
en.black-2: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
en.white-2: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
en.x: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
en.y: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
en.omega-ruby: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
en.alpha-sapphire: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
en.sword: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.
en.shield: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

es.x: Se cree que Conkeldurr enseñó a los humanos la técnica para elaborar cemento hace más de 2000 años.
es.y: En vez de hacer uso de la fuerza bruta, blande columnas de hormigón con la energía centrífuga de sus movimientos.
es.omega-ruby: Se cree que Conkeldurr enseñó a los humanos la técnica para elaborar cemento hace más de 2000 años.
es.alpha-sapphire: En vez de hacer uso de la fuerza bruta, blande columnas de hormigón con la energía centrífuga de sus movimientos.
es.sword: El hormigón que preparan los Conkeldurr es mucho más duro y resistente que el ordinario, aunque la composición sea la misma.
es.shield: Cuando decide ponerse en serio, suelta sus pilares de hormigón y se abalanza sobre el rival con solo un puño como arma.

en.black: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
en.white: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
en.black-2: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
en.white-2: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
en.x: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
en.y: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
en.omega-ruby: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
en.alpha-sapphire: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
en.sword: Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.
en.shield: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

es.x: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y advierte de algún peligro a los suyos.
es.y: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y se comunica con el ritmo de los mismos.
es.omega-ruby: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y advierte de algún peligro a los suyos.
es.alpha-sapphire: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y se comunica con el ritmo de los mismos.
es.sword: El agudo canto de los Tympole bajo el agua crea hermosas ondas que se extienden por la superficie.
es.shield: Se comunica con los suyos mediante ondas sonoras. Su grito de alerta es imperceptible para los humanos y el resto de los Pokémon.

en.black: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
en.white: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
en.black-2: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
en.white-2: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
en.x: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
en.y: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
en.omega-ruby: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
en.alpha-sapphire: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
en.sword: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.
en.shield: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

es.x: Cuando hace vibrar el bulto de su cabeza, no solo se embravece el mar, sino que la tierra también tiembla.
es.y: Vive tanto en tierra como en el fondo del mar. Con su larga y viscosa lengua, inmoviliza a sus contrincantes.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando hace vibrar el bulto de su cabeza, no solo se embravece el mar, sino que la tierra también tiembla.
es.alpha-sapphire: Vive tanto en tierra como en el fondo del mar. Con su larga y viscosa lengua, inmoviliza a sus contrincantes.
es.sword: Las ondas sonoras que emite pueden provocar dolor de cabeza. Con ellas debilita a sus presas para luego atraparlas con su lengua viscosa.
es.shield: A veces emiten un bello canto. Cuanto mayores son las protuberancias del cuerpo, más extenso es su registro vocal.

en.black: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
en.white: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
en.black-2: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
en.white-2: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
en.x: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
en.y: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
en.omega-ruby: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
en.alpha-sapphire: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
en.sword: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.
en.shield: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

es.x: Aumenta la potencia de sus puñetazos haciendo vibrar sus puños. Es capaz de quebrar una roca de un solo golpe.
es.y: Despide un líquido paralizador por los bultos de su cabeza. Atormenta a sus oponentes con enormes vibraciones.
es.omega-ruby: Aumenta la potencia de sus puñetazos haciendo vibrar sus puños. Es capaz de quebrar una roca de un solo golpe.
es.alpha-sapphire: Despide un líquido paralizador por los bultos de su cabeza. Atormenta a sus oponentes con enormes vibraciones.
es.sword: Cuando hace vibrar los bultos de su cuerpo, provoca sacudidas que parecen terremotos. Está emparentado con los Croagunk.
es.shield: Las vibraciones de sus bultos resultan perfectas para dar masajes, lo que lo ha hecho muy popular entre la tercera edad.

en.black: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
en.white: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.
en.black-2: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
en.white-2: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
en.x: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
en.y: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
en.omega-ruby: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
en.alpha-sapphire: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
en.sword: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.
en.shield: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

es.x: Aumenta su potencia si se aprieta el cinturón. Un Throh salvaje teje su propio cinturón usando lianas.
es.y: Si se topa con un rival más fuerte, ansía lanzarlo por los aires. Al hacerse más fuerte, cambia su cinturón.
es.omega-ruby: Aumenta su potencia si se aprieta el cinturón. Un Throh salvaje teje su propio cinturón usando lianas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Si se topa con un rival más fuerte, ansía lanzarlo por los aires. Al hacerse más fuerte, cambia su cinturón.
es.sword: Su técnica de lanzamiento es formidable. El sudor que exhala durante el combate impregna su cinturón, cuyo color se vuelve más intenso.
es.shield: Entrenan en grupos de cinco individuos. Si alguno es incapaz de seguir el ritmo, arroja el cinturón y abandona la cuadrilla.

en.black: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
en.white: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
en.black-2: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
en.white-2: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
en.x: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
en.y: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
en.omega-ruby: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
en.alpha-sapphire: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
en.sword: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.
en.shield: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

es.x: Para lograr dominar las técnicas de kárate más letales, se retiran a las montañas y entrenan día y noche.
es.y: La potencia de sus puñetazos aumenta si se aprieta el cinturón. Si le molestan cuando se entrena, se enfada.
es.omega-ruby: Para lograr dominar las técnicas de kárate más letales, se retiran a las montañas y entrenan día y noche.
es.alpha-sapphire: La potencia de sus puñetazos aumenta si se aprieta el cinturón. Si le molestan cuando se entrena, se enfada.

en.ultra-sun: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can’t move as well.

en.shield: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

es.x: Despide motas de algodón cuando lo atacan para confundir a los enemigos y poner pies en polvorosa.

es.moon: Los colchones o almohadas rellenos del algodón que suelta Cottonee son un producto de alta calidad por su ligereza y transpirabilidad.

es.shield: Combinando los algodones de los Cottonee y Eldegoss se obtiene una tela exquisita, que usan las marcas más exclusivas.

en.ultra-moon: Whimsicott doesn’t live in a fixed location. It floats around on whirling winds, appearing all over the place to perform its mischief.

en.shield: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

es.x: Aparecen en medio de un torbellino y entran en las casas para descolocar los muebles o esparcir algodón por doquier.

es.moon: Aparece al levantarse el viento, pero, cuando este arrecia, pierde el algodón de la cabeza.

es.shield: Su algodón se expande cuando recibe los rayos del sol, pero acaba desprendiéndose si se vuelve demasiado voluminoso.

en.black: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

en.moon: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.
en.ultra-sun: Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.
en.ultra-moon: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.
en.sword: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.
en.shield: The deeper the color of a Petilil’s leaves, the healthier the Pokémon is. Petilil sometimes makes its home in a well-tended field or flowerbed.
en.legends-arceus: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

es.x: Mordisquear las hojas de su cabeza permite recuperar toda la vitalidad, a pesar de que están muy amargas.
es.y: Habita tierras húmedas ricas en nutrientes donde la cosecha es abundante.
es.omega-ruby: Mordisquear las hojas de su cabeza permite recuperar toda la vitalidad, a pesar de que están muy amargas.

es.ultra-sun: Los ancianos aprecian las hojas de su cabeza, ya que, secadas al sol y tomadas en infusión, devuelven la vitalidad perdida.
es.ultra-moon: Prefiere el agua y la tierra sin impurezas. Si el entorno en el que habita empeora, emigra en grupo hacia un nuevo territorio.
es.sword: Aparece en lugares de aguas limpias. La decocción de las hojas de su cabeza se puede utilizar como repelente de insectos.
es.shield: Cuanto más sano está este Pokémon, más intenso se vuelve el color de sus hojas. A veces se asienta en huertos o jardines de flores bien cuidados.

en.black: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
en.white: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

en.ultra-sun: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.
en.ultra-moon: It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
en.sword: It’s believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant’s head to bloom.
en.shield: Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers have a sublime scent, but they’re also staggeringly expensive.
en.legends-arceus: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

es.x: El aroma de la flor de su tocado relaja a cualquiera a su alrededor. Hay que cuidarle mucho para que no se marchite.
es.y: Todos los famosos quieren uno de estos Pokémon. Incluso a los Entrenadores más curtidos les cuesta que florezca.
es.omega-ruby: El aroma de la flor de su tocado relaja a cualquiera a su alrededor. Hay que cuidarle mucho para que no se marchite.
es.alpha-sapphire: Todos los famosos quieren uno de estos Pokémon. Incluso a los Entrenadores más curtidos les cuesta que florezca.
es.sun: Por muchos esfuerzos o dinero que destine la gente para hacerla florecer, siempre es más bella la flor que brota en un ejemplar salvaje.
es.moon: Nada más encontrar un compañero, su bella flor comienza a languidecer y poco a poco se va marchitando sin remedio.
es.ultra-sun: El olor que desprende su flor varía en función de la composición de la tierra en la que crezca. Su aroma calma los nervios y sosiega el alma.
es.ultra-moon: Su belleza fascina a otros Pokémon. La flor de la cabeza se marchita enseguida si no se le presta el cuidado necesario.
es.sword: Se dice que conseguir que la flor de su cabeza florezca es una empresa titánica incluso para los mejores jardineros.
es.shield: El aceite esencial que se extrae de su flor emana un aroma sublime, aunque su precio resulta desorbitado.

en.shield: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it’s more popular with the youth.
en.legends-arceus: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

es.x: Los de color azul y los de color rojo siempre se pelean. Son muy violentos, pero su sabor es excepcional.
es.y: Los Basculin con la raya roja y aquellos con la raya azul se llevan fatal, pero algunos tienden a agruparse.

es.ultra-moon: Es tan violento que en los lagos donde aparece un banco de Basculin solo son capaces de quedarse Corphish o Crawdaunt.
es.sword: Muy popular entre los Pescadores por su fiereza. Ha proliferado debido a la introducción ilegal de ejemplares en los lagos.
es.shield: Un alimento básico de la dieta de antaño. A los jóvenes se les daba Basculin de raya roja por su alto contenido en ácidos grasos.
