en.ultra-sun: Alola, where it’s warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you’ll even see it outside of deserts.
en.ultra-moon: Sandile’s still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It’s called “the cleaner of the desert.”
en.sword: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.
en.shield: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

es.x: Se desplaza hundido en la arena, dejando al descubierto solo los ojos y la nariz. Una membrana negra le protege los ojos.
es.y: Vive en las arenas desérticas, donde las altas temperaturas de las mismas evitan que su cuerpo se enfríe.
es.omega-ruby: Se desplaza hundido en la arena, dejando al descubierto solo los ojos y la nariz. Una membrana negra le protege los ojos.
es.alpha-sapphire: Vive en las arenas desérticas, donde las altas temperaturas de las mismas evitan que su cuerpo se enfríe.
es.sun: Se desplaza sumergido bajo la arena, como si nadase. Así se esconde de sus enemigos y evita que descienda su temperatura corporal.
es.moon: Se desplaza hundido en la arena y atrapa a las presas incautas de la superficie mordiéndoles la pata. Su manjar favorito son los Trapinch.
es.ultra-sun: El hábitat de Alola, cálido durante todo el año, es ideal para este Pokémon, por lo que también se le puede ver fuera del desierto.
es.ultra-moon: Se nutre principalmente de cadáveres hallados en la arena, debido a su ineptitud para la caza. De ahí su apodo: el Barrendero del Desierto.
es.sword: En las frías noches del desierto se oculta a mucha profundidad en la arena y duerme hasta que sale el sol.
es.shield: Es pequeño, pero cuenta con un tren inferior fuerte. Se desplaza por el desierto abriéndose paso entre la arena, como si nadase.

en.black: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
en.white: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
en.black-2: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.
en.white-2: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.
en.x: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
en.y: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
en.omega-ruby: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
en.alpha-sapphire: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.
en.sun: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
en.moon: Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the middle of the night.
en.ultra-sun: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.
en.ultra-moon: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
en.sword: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.
en.shield: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

es.x: Viven en manadas. La membrana que cubre sus ojos los protege de la arena.
es.y: Una membrana especial cubre sus ojos y le permite detectar el calor de los cuerpos, por eso ve en la oscuridad.
es.omega-ruby: Viven en manadas. La membrana que cubre sus ojos los protege de la arena.
es.alpha-sapphire: Una membrana especial cubre sus ojos y le permite detectar el calor de los cuerpos, por eso ve en la oscuridad.
es.sun: Viven en manadas. En muchos casos, las hembras ejercen una posición dominante y los machos se encargan de buscar alimento.
es.moon: La membrana especial que le recubre los ojos le permite discernir con claridad lo que se halla a su alrededor, incluso en plena noche.
es.ultra-sun: Su gran debilidad es el frío, por lo que cuando bajan las temperaturas de noche en el desierto, excava un agujero en la arena y se cobija en él.
es.ultra-moon: Entierra parte de sus presas bajo la arena para reservarlas a modo de víveres de emergencia, en caso de una caza infructuosa.
es.sword: Es capaz de cazar en plena noche sin perderse gracias a sus ojos especiales, que le permiten ver en la oscuridad.
es.shield: Tiene unos ojos especiales que le permiten ver en la oscuridad, pero suele permanecer inmóvil en las frías noches del desierto.

en.black: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
en.white: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.
en.black-2: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
en.white-2: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
en.x: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
en.y: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
en.omega-ruby: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.
en.alpha-sapphire: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
en.sun: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
en.moon: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.
en.ultra-sun: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.
en.ultra-moon: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
en.sword: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.
en.shield: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

es.x: Un Pokémon bastante violento. Ataca todo lo que se mueva delante de él con sus mortíferas mandíbulas.
es.y: Jamás deja escapar a su presa. Sus mandíbulas son capaces de destrozar la carrocería de un coche.
es.omega-ruby: Un Pokémon bastante violento. Ataca todo lo que se mueva delante de él con sus mortíferas mandíbulas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Jamás deja escapar a su presa. Sus mandíbulas son capaces de destrozar la carrocería de un coche.
es.sun: Su vista es tan perspicaz que puede divisar presas de pequeño tamaño a 50 km de distancia, incluso en plena tormenta de arena.
es.moon: En cuanto le hinca el diente a su presa con sus potentes mandíbulas, comienza a retorcerle el cuerpo hasta despedazarla.
es.ultra-sun: Al avistar una presa incluso a 50 km, repta hacia ella por la arena como si nadara y se abalanza para despedazarla con sus fauces.
es.ultra-moon: Se oculta en las tormentas de arena provocadas por Flygon y espera pacientemente al acecho de su presa.
es.sword: Se lo conoce como el Terror de las Arenas. Con sus fuertes mandíbulas es capaz de destrozar a mordiscos una plancha de hierro fácilmente.
es.shield: Es de naturaleza violenta, pero también tiene la paciencia necesaria para esperar a su presa oculto en la arena durante varios días.

en.black: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
en.white: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
en.black-2: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100° F.
en.white-2: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100° F.
en.x: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
en.y: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
en.omega-ruby: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.
en.alpha-sapphire: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
en.sword: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.
en.shield: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

es.x: Como sus excrementos están muy calientes, la gente de antaño se los metía en los bolsillos para calentarse.
es.y: Cuando se dispone a dormir, retrae sus piernas y sus brazos, y reduce la llama de su interior a 600 °C para relajarse.
es.omega-ruby: Como sus excrementos están muy calientes, la gente de antaño se los metía en los bolsillos para calentarse.
es.alpha-sapphire: Cuando se dispone a dormir, retrae sus piernas y sus brazos, y reduce la llama de su interior a 600 °C para relajarse.
es.sword: La llama que arde en su interior es la fuente de su poder. Si el fuego mengua, se sume en un estado de sopor de inmediato.
es.shield: Cuando duerme es imposible tumbarlo por más que lo zarandeen. Es muy popular como amuleto de la suerte.

en.black: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
en.white: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.
en.black-2: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
en.white-2: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
en.x: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
en.y: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
en.omega-ruby: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.
en.alpha-sapphire: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
en.sword: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
en.shield: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

es.x: Cuando resulta gravemente herido, se endurece como una piedra y medita para agudizar la mente.
es.y: Genera llamas que alcanzan los 1400 °C con las que es capaz de destrozar un camión.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando resulta gravemente herido, se endurece como una piedra y medita para agudizar la mente.
es.alpha-sapphire: Genera llamas que alcanzan los 1400 °C con las que es capaz de destrozar un camión.
es.sword: Un Pokémon sumamente enérgico. Tiene tanta fuerza en los brazos que es capaz de destrozar un camión a base de puñetazos.
es.shield: Su fuerza aumenta cuanto más se aviva su fuego interior, que puede alcanzar temperaturas superiores a los 1400 °C.

en.black: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
en.white: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
en.black-2: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.
en.white-2: When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.
en.x: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
en.y: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
en.omega-ruby: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
en.alpha-sapphire: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
en.sword: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
en.shield: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

es.x: Espanta a los Pokémon pájaro con un baile rápido y haciendo ruido para evitar que picoteen las semillas de sus flores.
es.y: Vive en territorio árido. Emite un sonido parecido a unas maracas si se mueve de forma rítmica.
es.omega-ruby: Espanta a los Pokémon pájaro con un baile rápido y haciendo ruido para evitar que picoteen las semillas de sus flores.
es.alpha-sapphire: Vive en territorio árido. Emite un sonido parecido a unas maracas si se mueve de forma rítmica.
es.sword: Emite un sonido parecido a unas maracas. Se mueve con un ritmo marchoso para sorprender a los Pokémon pájaro, que huyen espantados.
es.shield: Una vez al año, esparce sus semillas, cuyo alto valor nutritivo las convierte en una inestimable fuente de alimento en el desierto.

en.black: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
en.white: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
en.black-2: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
en.white-2: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
en.x: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
en.y: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
en.omega-ruby: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
en.alpha-sapphire: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
en.sword: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.
en.shield: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

es.x: Abre un agujero en la roca y vive en él. Si la roca se resquebraja, no se queda tranquilo hasta que no encuentra otra.
es.y: Si encuentran una piedra de tamaño ideal, segregan un líquido por la boca para crear un agujero y deslizarse dentro.
es.omega-ruby: Abre un agujero en la roca y vive en él. Si la roca se resquebraja, no se queda tranquilo hasta que no encuentra otra.
es.alpha-sapphire: Si encuentran una piedra de tamaño ideal, segregan un líquido por la boca para crear un agujero y deslizarse dentro.
es.sword: Cuando halla una piedra de su agrado, la horada y establece su morada. Es enemigo natural de los Roggenrola y los Rolycoly.
es.shield: Si no encuentra una piedra que sea idónea como morada, se instala en los orificios de algún Hippowdon.

en.black: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
en.white: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
en.black-2: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
en.white-2: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
en.x: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
en.y: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
en.omega-ruby: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
en.alpha-sapphire: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
en.sword: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.
en.shield: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

es.x: Su inmensa capacidad motriz le permite desplazarse cargando a sus espaldas rocas enormes durante días.
es.y: Se disputa el territorio con sus congéneres. Pierde aquel al que le rompan la roca que lleva a cuestas.
es.omega-ruby: Su inmensa capacidad motriz le permite desplazarse cargando a sus espaldas rocas enormes durante días.
es.alpha-sapphire: Se disputa el territorio con sus congéneres. Pierde aquel al que le rompan la roca que lleva a cuestas.
es.sword: Este Pokémon posee un fuerte instinto territorial y prefiere los entornos áridos. Los días de lluvia permanece en el interior de su roca.
es.shield: Su arma más potente son sus gruesas pinzas, tan duras que pueden abrir una brecha incluso en el Protector de Rhyperior.

en.black: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
en.white: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
en.black-2: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
en.white-2: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
en.x: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
en.y: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
en.omega-ruby: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
en.alpha-sapphire: Proud of its sturdy skull, it suddenly headbutts everything, but its weight makes it unstable, too.
en.ultra-sun: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
en.ultra-moon: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.
en.sword: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.
en.shield: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

es.x: Se sube la piel hasta el cuello para defenderse. Su elasticidad, similar a la de una goma, reduce el daño recibido.
es.y: Está orgulloso de su sólido cráneo. Reparte cabezazos a diestro y siniestro con tal vehemencia que él mismo se marea.
es.omega-ruby: Se sube la piel hasta el cuello para defenderse. Su elasticidad, similar a la de una goma, reduce el daño recibido.
es.alpha-sapphire: Está orgulloso de su sólido cráneo. Reparte cabezazos a diestro y siniestro con tal vehemencia que él mismo se marea.
es.ultra-sun: Se desplaza con lentitud en pequeños grupos y se lía a cabezazos a la mínima que alguien le cruza la mirada.
es.ultra-moon: Se sube la piel arrugada hasta el cuello para protegerse. Parece que los ejemplares con la piel más larga son los más respetados.
es.sword: No tiene reparos en liarse a cabezazos con quien se le ponga por delante, por lo que es peligroso cruzar la mirada con él.
es.shield: Su robusta piel le sirve de protección. Cuando ya no puede estirarse más, es señal de que va a evolucionar pronto.

en.black: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
en.white: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
en.black-2: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
en.white-2: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
en.x: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
en.y: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
en.omega-ruby: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
en.alpha-sapphire: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.
en.ultra-sun: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
en.ultra-moon: It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.
en.sword: As halfhearted as this Pokémon’s kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr’s concrete pillars.
en.shield: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

es.x: Se protege de los ataques con la muda de su piel mientras reparte patadas. Cuanto mayor es su cresta, más se le respeta.
es.y: El líder del grupo es aquel cuya cresta es mayor. Es capaz de romper bloques de cemento con sus potentes patadas.
es.omega-ruby: Se protege de los ataques con la muda de su piel mientras reparte patadas. Cuanto mayor es su cresta, más se le respeta.
es.alpha-sapphire: El líder del grupo es aquel cuya cresta es mayor. Es capaz de romper bloques de cemento con sus potentes patadas.
es.ultra-sun: A pesar de su apariencia chulesca, se preocupa mucho por los miembros de su familia, el resto del grupo y su territorio.
es.ultra-moon: Provoca a su rival escupiéndole. No se aventura fuera de su propio territorio, donde pasa toda la vida.
es.sword: Las patadas que propina con aparente desgana poseen una fuerza capaz de destrozar incluso los pilares de hormigón que llevan los Conkeldurr.
es.shield: A pesar de su carácter agresivo, se muestra muy protector con sus allegados y su territorio.

en.black: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
en.white: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
en.black-2: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
en.white-2: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
en.x: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
en.y: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
en.omega-ruby: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.
en.alpha-sapphire: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
en.sword: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.
en.shield: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

es.x: Fue la deidad protectora de una ciudad milenaria. Ataca con su poder psíquico a los enemigos que invaden su territorio.
es.y: Deidad protectora de una antigua ciudad. Siempre merodea por la misma ruta y permanece alerta en busca de intrusos.
es.omega-ruby: Fue la deidad protectora de una ciudad milenaria. Ataca con su poder psíquico a los enemigos que invaden su territorio.
es.alpha-sapphire: Deidad protectora de una antigua ciudad. Siempre merodea por la misma ruta y permanece alerta en busca de intrusos.
es.sword: Vuela gracias a sus poderes psíquicos. Dicen que había sido la deidad protectora de una antigua ciudad, si bien otros creen que era su mensajero.
es.shield: Explorando la zona desértica que sobrevuela, se han descubierto los vestigios de lo que parece ser una antigua ciudad.

en.black: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
en.white: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.
en.black-2: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
en.white-2: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
en.x: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
en.y: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
en.omega-ruby: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves. Each retains memories of its former life.
en.alpha-sapphire: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
en.sword: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.
en.shield: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

es.x: Almas de humanos sepultados en tumbas que han adquirido forma de Pokémon. Recuerdan su vida antes de la muerte.
es.y: Su máscara representa la cara que poseía cuando era humano. A veces se le saltan las lágrimas al contemplarla.
es.omega-ruby: Almas de humanos sepultados en tumbas que han adquirido forma de Pokémon. Recuerdan su vida antes de la muerte.
es.alpha-sapphire: Su máscara representa la cara que poseía cuando era humano. A veces se le saltan las lágrimas al contemplarla.
es.sword: Merodea todas las noches entre ruinas. Se dice que la máscara que lleva replica su antiguo rostro humano.
es.shield: Surgió del alma de una persona que vivió en tiempos remotos. Merodea por las ruinas en busca de alguien que reconozca su rostro.

en.black: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
en.white: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.
en.black-2: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
en.white-2: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
en.x: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
en.y: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
en.omega-ruby: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
en.alpha-sapphire: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
en.sword: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.
en.shield: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

es.x: Se comenta que engulle a todo humano que se le acerca y lo momifica. Su comida favorita son las pepitas de oro.
es.y: Atrapan en su interior a los ladrones de tumbas que los confunden con ataúdes de verdad.
es.omega-ruby: Se comenta que engulle a todo humano que se le acerca y lo momifica. Su comida favorita son las pepitas de oro.
es.alpha-sapphire: Atrapan en su interior a los ladrones de tumbas que los confunden con ataúdes de verdad.
es.sword: Su cuerpo es de rutilante oro. Se dice que ya no recuerda nada de su pasado como humano.
es.shield: Aparece representado en los muros de antiguas sepulturas como símbolo de riqueza de reyes de antaño.

en.black: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
en.white: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
en.black-2: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.
en.white-2: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.
en.x: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
en.y: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
en.omega-ruby: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
en.alpha-sapphire: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
en.sun: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.
en.moon: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas approximately a hundred million years ago.
en.ultra-sun: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.
en.ultra-moon: Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area, from the land to more than half a mile deep in the ocean.
en.sword: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.
en.shield: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

es.x: Ya pululaba por las aguas hace 100 millones de años. También va a tierra a veces en busca de alimento.
es.y: Ha renacido de un fósil prehistórico. Puede sumergirse hasta 1000 m de profundidad.
es.omega-ruby: Ya pululaba por las aguas hace 100 millones de años. También va a tierra a veces en busca de alimento.
es.alpha-sapphire: Ha renacido de un fósil prehistórico. Puede sumergirse hasta 1000 m de profundidad.
es.sun: A juzgar por su estructura ósea, se calcula que podía sumergirse hasta 1 km de profundidad.
es.moon: Se dice que es el predecesor de numerosos Pokémon tortuga. Hace unos 100 millones de años ya habitaba mares templados.
es.ultra-sun: Se ha logrado reconstruir a partir de fósiles. Aunque viviera en el mar, no dudaba en salir del agua a tierra firme en busca de presas.
es.ultra-moon: Poseía un vasto territorio de caza, que abarcaba desde la tierra firme hasta una profundidad marina de 1 km.
es.sword: Vivía en los mares de hace millones de años. Sale a tierra para buscar presas, aunque solo se pueda desplazar reptando.
es.shield: Se piensa que es el antepasado de numerosos Pokémon tortuga. Fue regenerado a partir de un fósil.

en.black: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
en.white: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
en.black-2: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.
en.white-2: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.
en.x: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
en.y: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.
en.omega-ruby: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
en.alpha-sapphire: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.
en.sun: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.
en.moon: Active both on land and in the sea, this Pokémon drags its land-based prey into the water to finish it off.
en.ultra-sun: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.
en.ultra-moon: Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.
en.sword: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta’s own shell grows thick and sturdy.
en.shield: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

es.x: Vive en el mar y en la superficie. Sus garras pueden abrir un agujero en el fondo de un petrolero.
es.y: Un golpe con sus desarrolladas aletas delanteras puede hacer perder a un rival el conocimiento o romperle los huesos.
es.omega-ruby: Vive en el mar y en la superficie. Sus garras pueden abrir un agujero en el fondo de un petrolero.
es.alpha-sapphire: Un golpe con sus desarrolladas aletas delanteras puede hacer perder a un rival el conocimiento o romperle los huesos.
es.sun: Trituraba los huesos y las duras conchas de sus presas para aprovechar bien los nutrientes y reforzar así su propio caparazón.
es.moon: Vive tanto en el mar como en la superficie. En tierra firme, caza a sus presas y las arrastra hacia el mar, donde les da el golpe de gracia.
es.ultra-sun: La brutal presión que ejerce con su mandíbula es tal que las conchas de Omastar y Omanyte no son ninguna molestia cuando los devora.
es.ultra-moon: Para reforzar aún más su robusto caparazón, engulle incluso las conchas y los huesos de las presas que captura.
es.sword: Devora incluso los huesos y caparazones de sus presas, por lo que el suyo propio se vuelve duro y grueso.
es.shield: Aunque se mueva con mayor lentitud sobre la superficie terrestre que en el agua, emerge a tierra en busca de presas.

en.black: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
en.white: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
en.black-2: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.
en.white-2: It was revived from an ancient fossil. Not able to fly, it lived in treetops and hopped from one branch to another.
en.x: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
en.y: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
en.omega-ruby: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.
en.alpha-sapphire: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
en.sun: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.
en.moon: To all appearances flightless, it was able to glide down from tall treetops to snag its prey.
en.ultra-sun: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.
en.ultra-moon: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.
en.sword: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it’s very good at jumping.
en.shield: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

es.x: Pokémon que renació de un fósil. Dicen que es el antepasado de todos los Pokémon pájaro.
es.y: Dicen que es el Pokémon pájaro primigenio. No puede volar, así que solo salta de rama en rama.
es.omega-ruby: Pokémon que renació de un fósil. Dicen que es el antepasado de todos los Pokémon pájaro.
es.alpha-sapphire: Dicen que es el Pokémon pájaro primigenio. No puede volar, así que solo salta de rama en rama.
es.sun: El antecesor de todo Pokémon pájaro. Como era incapaz de volar, se desplazaba saltando de árbol en árbol.
es.moon: Al parecer no podía volar, por lo que se lanzaba desde las copas de árboles altos para planear y atrapar así a su presa.
es.ultra-sun: Siempre se ha creído que era el antecesor de los Pokémon pájaro, aunque investigaciones recientes lo ponen en duda.
es.ultra-moon: Este Pokémon pájaro ancestral, regenerado a partir de un fósil, es incapaz de volar pese a tener alas.
es.sword: Fue regenerado a partir de un fósil. Tal y como apuntaban las investigaciones, no puede volar, pero los saltos son su punto fuerte.
es.shield: Se dice que es el antepasado de los Pokémon pájaro. Vivía en las copas de los árboles y se alimentaba de bayas y Pokémon insecto.

en.black: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
en.white: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.
en.black-2: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
en.white-2: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
en.x: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
en.y: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
en.omega-ruby: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
en.alpha-sapphire: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
en.sun: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.
en.moon: They hunted in flocks. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.
en.ultra-sun: This ancient Pokémon’s plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.
en.ultra-moon: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.
en.sword: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
en.shield: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

es.x: Levanta el vuelo tras coger carrerilla. Coopera con sus compañeros de bandada para atrapar a sus presas.
es.y: Corre a mayor velocidad de la que puede volar. Alcanza una velocidad de 40 km/h antes de alzarse en vuelo hacia el cielo.
es.omega-ruby: Levanta el vuelo tras coger carrerilla. Coopera con sus compañeros de bandada para atrapar a sus presas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Corre a mayor velocidad de la que puede volar. Alcanza una velocidad de 40 km/h antes de alzarse en vuelo hacia el cielo.
es.sun: Pese a haber desarrollado la capacidad de volar, prefería seguir corriendo por la superficie terrestre, con una velocidad media de 40 km/h.
es.moon: Se agrupaban en bandadas para salir de caza. Primero, unos arrinconaban a la presa y luego otros se lanzaban en picado sobre ella.
es.ultra-sun: Pokémon vetusto de plumaje tan fino que solo alguien con extremada pericia puede regenerar a partir de un fósil.
es.ultra-moon: Precursor de los Pokémon pájaro. Para alzar el vuelo necesita coger carrerilla, debido a una musculatura en las alas poco desarrollada.
es.sword: Coge carrerilla durante aproximadamente 4 km a una velocidad de 40 km/h para poder levantar el vuelo.
es.shield: Si bien era capaz de volar, parece ser que se le daba mucho mejor cazar presas en tierra firme que en el aire.

en.black: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
en.white: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
en.black-2: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
en.white-2: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
en.x: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
en.y: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
en.omega-ruby: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.
en.alpha-sapphire: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
en.sun: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.
en.moon: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of gas will put a person in the hospital.
en.ultra-sun: Poisonous gas leaks out of it when it breathes. Muk that catch a whiff of that stench will come drooling.
en.ultra-moon: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.
en.sword: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
en.shield: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

es.x: Pokémon nacido de la reacción química entre una bolsa de basura y residuos industriales.
es.y: Le gustan los lugares con suciedad. Quien inhala los gases que eructa duerme durante una semana.
es.omega-ruby: Pokémon nacido de la reacción química entre una bolsa de basura y residuos industriales.
es.alpha-sapphire: Le gustan los lugares con suciedad. Quien inhala los gases que eructa duerme durante una semana.
es.sun: Le gustan los lugares sucios. En Alola se lo suele ver junto a Grimer, que lo sigue a todas partes.
es.moon: Tras atiborrarse de basura, eructa unos gases venenosos capaces de llevar a cualquiera al hospital en caso de inhalarlos sin querer.
es.ultra-sun: Expulsa gases nocivos al respirar. Cuando Muk se percata del olor, acude salivando.
es.ultra-moon: Los gases que exhala a modo de eructos pueden poner en peligro la vida de niños y crías Pokémon que los inhalen de forma accidental.
es.sword: Le gustan los lugares insalubres. Puede llegar a establecerse en las casas de aquellas personas que no hagan la limpieza con regularidad.
es.shield: Nació a partir de una rebosante bolsa de basura. Los gases nocivos que eructa son un manjar para los Weezing de Galar.

en.black: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
en.white: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.
en.black-2: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
en.white-2: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
en.x: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
en.y: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
en.omega-ruby: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
en.alpha-sapphire: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
en.sun: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you’ll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.
en.moon: For a time, their numbers increased explosively in Alola. Since the arrival of Grimer, their population has decreased dramatically.
en.ultra-sun: It locks opponents in place with its left hand, immobilizing them by entirely dousing their bodies with poisonous liquid.
en.ultra-moon: Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.
en.sword: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
en.shield: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

es.x: Apresa a su rival con el brazo izquierdo y le da el golpe de gracia exhalando por la boca un apestoso gas venenoso.
es.y: Absorbe y procesa en su interior basura para generar nuevos gases nocivos y líquidos venenosos de alta virulencia.
es.omega-ruby: Apresa a su rival con el brazo izquierdo y le da el golpe de gracia exhalando por la boca un apestoso gas venenoso.
es.alpha-sapphire: Absorbe y procesa en su interior basura para generar nuevos gases nocivos y líquidos venenosos de alta virulencia.
es.sun: El veneno líquido que brota de su brazo derecho es muy nocivo. La mera exposición puede llevar a inhalar accidentalmente toxinas desconocidas.
es.moon: Hubo un tiempo en el que la población de Garbodor en Alola era espectacular, pero su número se desplomó cuando llegaron los Grimer.
es.ultra-sun: Atrapa a su presa con el brazo izquierdo y luego rocía su cuerpo con un líquido venenoso para inmovilizarla.
es.ultra-moon: La razón de la mayor fortaleza de los Garbodor que viven en la región de Alola se atribuye a la presencia de Muk, su enemigo natural.
es.sword: Su cuerpo transforma la inmundicia que engulle en un veneno cuya composición cambia según la basura ingerida.
es.shield: El veneno líquido que brota de su brazo derecho es tan nocivo que puede acabar con una criatura ya débil al menor contacto.

en.black: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
en.white: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
en.black-2: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
en.white-2: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
en.x: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
en.y: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
en.omega-ruby: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
en.alpha-sapphire: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.
en.ultra-sun: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
en.ultra-moon: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
en.sword: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua’s ability to take on the forms of other creatures.
en.shield: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.
en.legends-arceus: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

es.x: Adopta la apariencia de su enemigo para engañarlo vilmente y aprovecha su estupor para poner tierra por medio.
es.y: Se transforma en humanos o en otros Pokémon. Se defiende del peligro ocultando su verdadera apariencia.
es.omega-ruby: Adopta la apariencia de su enemigo para engañarlo vilmente y aprovecha su estupor para poner tierra por medio.
es.alpha-sapphire: Se transforma en humanos o en otros Pokémon. Se defiende del peligro ocultando su verdadera apariencia.
es.ultra-sun: Es tan miedoso que, cuando no se halla junto a sus compañeros, casi siempre adopta un aspecto distinto.
es.ultra-moon: Si un niño parlanchín se vuelve taciturno, tal vez pueda tratarse en realidad de un Zorua que ha adoptado su aspecto.
es.sword: Al parecer, fue su carácter miedoso lo que le llevó a desarrollar la capacidad de transformarse.
es.shield: Suele transformarse en personas, sobre todo en niños, y se adentra en pueblos buscando comida.

en.black: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
en.white: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
en.black-2: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
en.white-2: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
en.x: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
en.y: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
en.omega-ruby: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.
en.alpha-sapphire: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
en.ultra-sun: It doesn’t just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
en.ultra-moon: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
en.sword: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.
en.shield: Seeking to ease the burden of their solitude, lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusions to them.
en.legends-arceus: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

es.x: Tiene la facultad de confundir a muchos humanos a la vez. Protege su guarida creando un paisaje ilusorio.
es.y: Siempre ha protegido a su manada embaucando a sus enemigos. Dentro de la manada están todos muy unidos.
es.omega-ruby: Tiene la facultad de confundir a muchos humanos a la vez. Protege su guarida creando un paisaje ilusorio.
es.alpha-sapphire: Siempre ha protegido a su manada embaucando a sus enemigos. Dentro de la manada están todos muy unidos.
es.ultra-sun: No solo es capaz de transformarse, sino que también puede crear ilusiones para confundir a cientos de personas.
es.ultra-moon: Si percibe que un humano está amenazando su hábitat, crea visiones para aturdirlo y hacerlo vagar por el bosque sin cesar.
es.sword: Cuida de sus semejantes. Provoca ilusiones terroríficas para proteger tanto su guarida como a su manada de sus adversarios.
es.shield: Los Entrenadores solitarios le piden a Zoroark que les muestre ilusiones con las que combatir la desazón de la soledad.

en.black: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
en.white: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
en.black-2: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
en.white-2: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
en.x: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
en.y: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
en.omega-ruby: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
en.alpha-sapphire: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.
en.ultra-sun: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.
en.ultra-moon: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.
en.sword: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
en.shield: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

es.x: Se saludan entre sí frotándose con la cola y limpiándose a conciencia.
es.y: Le encanta la limpieza. Usa su cola a modo de escoba y se pasa el día barre que te barre.
es.omega-ruby: Se saludan entre sí frotándose con la cola y limpiándose a conciencia.
es.alpha-sapphire: Le encanta la limpieza. Usa su cola a modo de escoba y se pasa el día barre que te barre.
es.ultra-sun: Este Pokémon es extremadamente pulcro y no puede ver ni una mota de suciedad o la limpiará usando su cola como si fuera una mopa.
es.ultra-moon: Tras usar la cola para limpiar su madriguera o su propio cuerpo, se pasa un día entero lavándosela con agua de manantial.
es.sword: Usa la cola para barrer la basurilla. Su extrema pulcritud es tanto una ayuda en la limpieza del hogar como un incordio.
es.shield: Se saludan entre sí frotándose la cola. Cuanto más voluminosa es, más orgullosos se muestran.

en.black: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
en.white: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
en.black-2: Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
en.white-2: Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
en.x: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
en.y: Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
en.omega-ruby: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.
en.alpha-sapphire: Cinccino’s body is coated in a special oil that helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.
en.ultra-sun: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies’ attacks.
en.ultra-moon: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.
en.sword: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
en.shield: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

es.x: El pelo que cubre su cuerpo proporciona una agradable sensación al tocarlo. No acumula ni polvo ni electricidad estática.
es.y: El cuerpo de Cinccino está recubierto por una grasa especial que hace que los golpes y ataques enemigos no acierten.
es.omega-ruby: El pelo que cubre su cuerpo proporciona una agradable sensación al tocarlo. No acumula ni polvo ni electricidad estática.
es.alpha-sapphire: El cuerpo de Cinccino está recubierto por una grasa especial que hace que los golpes y ataques enemigos no acierten.
es.ultra-sun: Su níveo pelaje está recubierto de una sustancia oleosa, secretada por su propio cuerpo, que hace resbalar los golpes enemigos.
es.ultra-moon: La grasa que exuda por todo el cuerpo es muy lubrificante y altamente apreciada por las personas con problemas de piel seca.
es.sword: Es tan sumamente pulcro que no puede ver ni una mota de polvo. La grasa que exuda por el cuerpo le sirve de película protectora.
es.shield: Su pelaje está recubierto por una grasa especial que repele los ataques enemigos y por la que se llegan a pagar auténticas fortunas.

en.black: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
en.white: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
en.black-2: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn’t notice attacks.
en.white-2: It stares intently at everything. It can become so obsessed with watching that it doesn’t notice attacks.

en.shield: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

es.x: Amplifica su poder psíquico con sus antenitas en forma de lazo. Siempre está mirando algo fijamente.
es.y: Clava su mirada en Pokémon y Entrenadores como si observara algo solo perceptible por él.

es.sword: Pese a ser todavía un bebé, puede luchar con el poder psíquico que acumula en las antenitas en forma de lazos.
es.shield: A veces susurra aunque no haya nadie alrededor. Por eso se cree que tal vez hable con alguien o algo imperceptible para los demás.

en.black: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
en.white: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
en.black-2: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
en.white-2: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.

en.sword: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.
en.shield: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

es.x: La luz de las estrellas origina su poder. De noche, marca su posición haciendo levitar piedras con su poder psíquico.
es.y: Según muchas leyendas, durante las noches estrelladas controlan a los niños que duermen, tan solo como diversión.

es.sword: Corre el rumor de que en las noches estrelladas se lleva consigo a los niños dormidos, por lo que recibe el sobrenombre de Bruja Castigadora.
es.shield: Sus poderes psíquicos alcanzan su apogeo en las noches estrelladas, aunque su posible vínculo con el espacio está envuelto en misterio.

en.black: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
en.white: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers’ life spans.
en.black-2: It can see the future from the movement of the stars. When it learns its Trainer’s life span, it cries in sadness.

en.shield: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

es.x: Su inmenso poder psíquico distorsiona el espacio y le permite reflejar incluso estrellas a años luz de distancia.
es.y: Predice el futuro analizando la posición de los astros y su movimiento. Conoce la esperanza de vida de los Entrenadores.
es.omega-ruby: Su inmenso poder psíquico distorsiona el espacio y le permite reflejar incluso estrellas a años luz de distancia.

es.sword: Predice el futuro observando el movimiento de las estrellas. Posee un poder psíquico tremendo, pero evita los conflictos por su buen carácter.
es.shield: Los malhechores a los que revela sus últimos momentos pierden la vida el mismo día.

es.x: Gracias a la sustancia viscosa que envuelve su cuerpo, permanece tranquilo por dura o rigurosa que sea la situación.
es.y: Desata su poder psíquico para ahuyentar al enemigo. Se comunica con sus compañeros por telepatía.

es.shield: Se cree que la sustancia viscosa que lo envuelve le permite sobrevivir en el espacio exterior.

en.black: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

es.x: Dado que su cerebro está dividido en dos, a veces tiene conflictos a la hora de decidir qué hacer.
es.y: Cuando las dos partes de su cerebro piensan lo mismo, saca todo su poder a relucir.

es.shield: Las dos partes de su cerebro casi nunca piensan lo mismo, por lo que es imposible predecir sus intenciones.

es.shield: Al parecer, beber su líquido especial otorga un intelecto sin par, pero resulta muy venenoso, excepto para los propios Reuniclus.

en.black: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
en.white: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.
en.black-2: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.
en.white-2: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

en.sun: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.
en.moon: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.
en.ultra-sun: It exhales cold air that is at –58 degrees Fahrenheit. When it’s in a warm place, it shrinks little by little.
en.ultra-moon: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.
en.sword: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.
en.shield: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

es.x: Lanza un aliento de -50 °C. Crea bloques de nieve y es capaz de lograr que nieve a su alrededor.
es.y: Nació de un carámbano que absorbió la energía del sol al alba. Duerme arropado por la nieve.
es.omega-ruby: Lanza un aliento de -50 °C. Crea bloques de nieve y es capaz de lograr que nieve a su alrededor.
es.alpha-sapphire: Nació de un carámbano que absorbió la energía del sol al alba. Duerme arropado por la nieve.
es.sun: Pokémon nacido de un carámbano. Con su aliento gélido es capaz de crear cristales de nieve y provocar una nevasca.
es.moon: Al abrazarlo transmite una sensación agradable y refrescante. La gente que vive en las regiones cálidas aprecia mucho su presencia en casa.
es.ultra-sun: Exhala vaho a una temperatura de -50 ºC. Su tamaño corporal se reduce poco a poco cuando se encuentra en un lugar cálido.
es.ultra-moon: Nació a partir del deseo de una estalactita de no derretirse con los rayos del albor. Por la noche se arropa bajo la nieve para dormir.
es.sword: No puede vivir en lugares muy cálidos. Provoca nevadas exhalando un vaho gélido y luego se acurruca en la nieve acumulada para dormir.
es.shield: Este Pokémon nació a partir de un carámbano. Exhala un vaho a -50 °C con el que congela el ambiente para adaptarlo a sus necesidades.

en.black: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
en.white: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.
en.black-2: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.
en.white-2: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

en.sun: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.
en.moon: This Pokémon has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.
en.ultra-sun: It sprays its enemies with grains of ice to freeze them. Most Vanillish in Alola are smaller than average.
en.ultra-moon: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.
en.sword: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.
en.shield: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

es.x: Enfrían el aire a su alrededor y crean partículas de hielo mediante las cuales congelan a sus oponentes.
es.y: Vive en las cumbres nevadas. Migró hacia el sur durante la era glaciar hace muchísimos años.
es.omega-ruby: Enfrían el aire a su alrededor y crean partículas de hielo mediante las cuales congelan a sus oponentes.

es.moon: Sus orígenes se remontan a la era glacial. Usa partículas de hielo para congelar a su enemigo y hacerlo después añicos de un cabezazo.
es.ultra-sun: Exhala partículas de hielo para congelar a sus rivales. Los Vanillish de la región de Alola son más pequeños que el resto.
es.ultra-moon: Un Pokémon muy resistente que logró sobrevivir a la glaciación. En las regiones cálidas goza de gran popularidad.
es.sword: Bebe agua pura para agrandar su cuerpo de hielo. Apenas se ven ejemplares durante los días soleados.
es.shield: Congela a sus enemigos con un vaho a -100 °C, pero no llega a arrebatarles la vida debido a su carácter benévolo.

en.black: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
en.white: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
en.black-2: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

en.moon: Even if it loses one of its heads, it can live relatively problem-free. It makes snow clouds inside its body.
en.ultra-sun: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.
en.ultra-moon: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day’s light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.
en.sword: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.
en.shield: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

es.x: Si sus dos cabezas se irritan al mismo tiempo, genera una ventisca desde su cuerno cubriendo su entorno con nieve.
es.y: Absorben grandes cantidades de agua y la transforman en ventisca en su cuerpo, expulsándola cuando se enojan.
es.omega-ruby: Si sus dos cabezas se irritan al mismo tiempo, genera una ventisca desde su cuerno cubriendo su entorno con nieve.

es.ultra-sun: Expulsa ventiscas por ambas bocas y, como puede crear nieve en cualquier lugar, es famoso entre quienes practican esquí o snowboard.
es.ultra-moon: Su nacimiento se produce cuando dos Vanillish se derriten por la mañana, se mezclan y, durante la gélida noche, se congelan juntos.
es.sword: Cuando su rabia alcanza el punto máximo, genera una ventisca que congela tanto a amigos como a enemigos.
es.shield: Su temperatura corporal ronda los -6 °C. Se dice que nace de la fusión de dos Vanillish.

en.sun: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.
en.moon: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.
en.ultra-sun: They store up electricity to fly through the air. When thunder cracks at night, sometimes there are almost enough of them to blot out the sky.
en.ultra-moon: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That’s why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.
en.sword: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.
en.shield: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

es.x: Vive en la copa de los árboles. Produce descargas mientras vuela con el interior de la membrana que hace de capa.
es.y: Almacena en una membrana la electricidad generada por sus mejillas y planea por los aires soltando descargas.
es.omega-ruby: Vive en la copa de los árboles. Produce descargas mientras vuela con el interior de la membrana que hace de capa.
es.alpha-sapphire: Almacena en una membrana la electricidad generada por sus mejillas y planea por los aires soltando descargas.
es.sun: Planea con su membrana, que hace las veces de capa. La electricidad que despide electrocuta sin distinción a enemigos y aliados.
es.moon: Suelta una descarga eléctrica para achicharrar bayas o Pokémon insecto. Suele habitar los nidos que los Pikipek horadan en los árboles.
es.ultra-sun: Se carga de electricidad y se echa a volar. Durante las noches de tormenta eléctrica se los ve a centenares surcando el cielo.
es.ultra-moon: Desprende descargas eléctricas mientras vuela, por lo que los Pokémon pájaro no se le acercan, y así puede quedarse la comida para él solo.
es.sword: Planea por el aire, casi como si danzara, mientras desprende electricidad. Resulta adorable, pero puede causar bastantes problemas.
es.shield: Le encantan las bayas dulces. A veces almacena tanta comida en los carrillos que no puede volar bien.

en.black: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
en.white: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.
en.black-2: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
en.white-2: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
en.x: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
en.y: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
en.omega-ruby: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
en.alpha-sapphire: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
en.sword: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.
en.shield: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

es.x: Si recibe un estímulo eléctrico al estar en contacto con un Shelmet, evoluciona.
es.y: Si recibe una descarga eléctrica durante un combate contra un Shelmet, puede evolucionar. Se desconoce el porqué.
es.omega-ruby: Si recibe un estímulo eléctrico al estar en contacto con un Shelmet, evoluciona.
es.alpha-sapphire: Si recibe una descarga eléctrica durante un combate contra un Shelmet, puede evolucionar. Se desconoce el porqué.
es.sword: Su misterioso cuerpo reacciona a la energía eléctrica. Si se encuentra en presencia de un Shelmet, evoluciona.
es.shield: Escupe un líquido corrosivo con el que disuelve el caparazón de los Shelmet para luego devorar el contenido.

en.black: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
en.white: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
en.black-2: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
en.white-2: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
en.x: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
en.y: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

en.alpha-sapphire: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
en.sword: They use shells they’ve stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They’re very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.
en.shield: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

es.x: Se defienden de los ataques con el caparazón que roban a los Shelmet. Atacan con sus dos mortíferas lanzas.
es.y: Pokémon que evolucionó poniéndose el caparazón de Shelmet. Su armazón de acero le protege todo el cuerpo.
es.omega-ruby: Se defienden de los ataques con el caparazón que roban a los Shelmet. Atacan con sus dos mortíferas lanzas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Pokémon que evolucionó poniéndose el caparazón de Shelmet. Su armazón de acero le protege todo el cuerpo.
es.sword: Le roba el caparazón a un Shelmet y lo usa como armadura. Este Pokémon es extremadamente popular en la región de Galar.
es.shield: Ataca a los enemigos con sus lanzas. Aparece representado en pleno duelo contra un Sirfetch’d en un famoso cuadro.

en.black: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
en.white: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.
en.black-2: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.
en.white-2: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.
en.x: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
en.y: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.

en.alpha-sapphire: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.
en.sword: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.
en.shield: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

es.x: Gracias a su misterioso parecido a una Poké Ball, atrae a sus presas y lanza rápidamente esporas de veneno.
es.y: Atraen a otros Pokémon gracias a su similitud con una Poké Ball y los atacan expulsando esporas venenosas.
es.omega-ruby: Gracias a su misterioso parecido a una Poké Ball, atrae a sus presas y lanza rápidamente esporas de veneno.
es.alpha-sapphire: Atraen a otros Pokémon gracias a su similitud con una Poké Ball y los atacan expulsando esporas venenosas.
es.sword: Todavía no se ha encontrado ninguna explicación ni razón para su gran parecido a las Poké Balls.
es.shield: Las esporas que expulsa por las extremidades son altamente tóxicas, pero, si se secan bien, sirven como remedio estomacal.

en.black: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
en.white: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
en.black-2: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.
en.white-2: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.
en.x: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
