en.alpha-sapphire: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
en.ultra-sun: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.
en.ultra-moon: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.
en.sword: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.
en.shield: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

es.x: La velocidad de sus ataques es su gran orgullo. Lo que le falta de fuerza bruta lo compensa en cantidad de golpes.
es.y: Abruma a su rival con oleadas de ataques veloces. Corta al enemigo con sus afiladas garras.
es.omega-ruby: La velocidad de sus ataques es su gran orgullo. Lo que le falta de fuerza bruta lo compensa en cantidad de golpes.
es.alpha-sapphire: Abruma a su rival con oleadas de ataques veloces. Corta al enemigo con sus afiladas garras.
es.ultra-sun: A primera hora de la mañana pueden verse grupos de Mienfoo realizando movimientos lentos y adoptando distintas poses.
es.ultra-moon: Suele recluirse con otros congéneres en las montañas para entrenar. Según el grupo, la técnica de sus patadas o puñetazos varía.
es.sword: Un Mienfoo bien entrenado es capaz de propinar más de cien golpes por minuto.
es.shield: Su apariencia menuda contrasta con su carácter poco afable. Abruma a los rivales que se acercan a él con gráciles oleadas de ataques sucesivos.

en.black: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
en.white: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
en.black-2: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
en.white-2: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
en.x: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
en.y: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
en.omega-ruby: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
en.alpha-sapphire: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.
en.ultra-sun: It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.
en.ultra-moon: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you’re in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!
en.sword: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.
en.shield: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

es.x: Usa el pelaje de sus brazos a manera de látigos. Sus ataques alcanzan velocidades de vértigo.
es.y: Usa el pelaje de sus brazos a modo de látigos para encadenar ataques que nadie puede parar una vez iniciados.
es.omega-ruby: Usa el pelaje de sus brazos a manera de látigos. Sus ataques alcanzan velocidades de vértigo.
es.alpha-sapphire: Usa el pelaje de sus brazos a modo de látigos para encadenar ataques que nadie puede parar una vez iniciados.
es.ultra-sun: Ataca al rival con una rápida ráfaga de golpes, mientras reúne poco a poco la energía necesaria para asestar el golpe definitivo.
es.ultra-moon: Si emite extraños aullidos, hay que extremar la precaución: empezará a repartir un sinfín de patadas y puñetazos a una velocidad pasmosa.
es.sword: Cuando se encuentra frente a un oponente de categoría, se arranca parte del pelaje de los brazos a mordiscos para ganar agilidad.
es.shield: Sus veloces patadas, que escapan al ojo humano, son capaces de reducir a escombros incluso rocas de gran tamaño.

en.black: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
en.white: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
en.black-2: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.
en.white-2: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.
en.x: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
en.y: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
en.omega-ruby: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.
en.alpha-sapphire: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
en.ultra-sun: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
en.ultra-moon: It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.
en.sword: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.
en.shield: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

es.x: Corre por estrechas cavernas y atrapa a sus presas con sus afiladas garras. La piel de la cara es más dura que una roca.
es.y: Calienta su cuerpo absorbiendo los rayos de sol por las alas. No se puede mover si baja su temperatura corporal.
es.omega-ruby: Corre por estrechas cavernas y atrapa a sus presas con sus afiladas garras. La piel de la cara es más dura que una roca.
es.alpha-sapphire: Calienta su cuerpo absorbiendo los rayos de sol por las alas. No se puede mover si baja su temperatura corporal.
es.ultra-sun: La piel roja de su cara es más dura que una roca. La usa para atacar a sus enemigos cuando los acorrala en cuevas angostas.
es.ultra-moon: Aprovecha los túneles excavados por los Diglett y Dugtrio para esperar tranquilamente en su interior a que alguna presa pase cerca.
es.sword: Habita en túneles. Pierde la movilidad si baja su temperatura corporal, por lo que aprovecha la menor oportunidad para tomar el sol.
es.shield: Posee una personalidad despiadada y ladina. Se apropia de los túneles excavados por otros Pokémon y los habita.

en.black: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
en.white: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.
en.black-2: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
en.white-2: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
en.x: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
en.y: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
en.omega-ruby: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
en.alpha-sapphire: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
en.ultra-sun: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.
en.ultra-moon: Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.
en.sword: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
en.shield: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

es.x: Se mueve gracias a la energía que quema dentro de su cuerpo, pero el origen de esta energía es incierto.
es.y: Un Pokémon creado a partir del barro gracias a la ciencia de antaño. Lleva activo miles de años.
es.omega-ruby: Se mueve gracias a la energía que quema dentro de su cuerpo, pero el origen de esta energía es incierto.
es.alpha-sapphire: Un Pokémon creado a partir del barro gracias a la ciencia de antaño. Lleva activo miles de años.
es.ultra-sun: Se mueve gracias a una misteriosa energía, pero, habiendo estado activo desde la antigüedad, dicha energía podría agotarse tarde o temprano.
es.ultra-moon: Se dice que fue creado antiguamente a partir de arcilla para usarlo como sirviente, pero se desconoce cuál es su fuente de energía.
es.sword: Un antiguo Pokémon creado a partir del barro. Se desconoce el motivo por el que algunos ejemplares colocan rocas grandes en hileras.
es.shield: Fue creado a partir del barro para emplearlo como sirviente. Todavía acata las órdenes que le dio su amo hace milenios.

en.black: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
en.white: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
en.black-2: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
en.white-2: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
en.x: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
en.y: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
en.omega-ruby: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
en.alpha-sapphire: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
en.ultra-sun: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master’s orders faithfully.
en.ultra-moon: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.
en.sword: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
en.shield: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

es.x: Al parecer, aquel que antaño lo creó le ordenó proteger a los Pokémon y a los humanos.
es.y: Vuela a velocidad mach. Pierde el control de su energía si se le retira el sello del pecho.
es.omega-ruby: Al parecer, aquel que antaño lo creó le ordenó proteger a los Pokémon y a los humanos.
es.alpha-sapphire: Vuela a velocidad mach. Pierde el control de su energía si se le retira el sello del pecho.
es.ultra-sun: Se dice que fue creado en la antigüedad para usarlo como mano de obra. Acata las órdenes de su amo sin rechistar.
es.ultra-moon: Si se le desprende el sello del pecho, pierde el control y arrasa con todo sin miramientos: puede convertir un pueblo en un montón de escombros.
es.sword: En los muros de antiguos castillos se hallan plataformas desde las que los Golurk podían disparar sus rayos como si fueran cañones.
es.shield: Se dice que su cuerpo alberga un móvil perpetuo que genera energía, pero no se ha constatado la veracidad de tamaña afirmación.

en.black: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
en.white: They fight at Bisharp’s command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.
en.black-2: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
en.white-2: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
en.x: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
en.y: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
en.omega-ruby: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
en.alpha-sapphire: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
en.ultra-sun: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.
en.ultra-moon: It follows Bisharp’s orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.
en.sword: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.
en.shield: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

es.x: Su cuerpo está provisto de hojas afiladas. Cuando se desgastan, las afila con cantos rodados a la orilla del río.
es.y: Ataca en grupo ignorando sus heridas y hundiendo en su presa las cuchillas que recubren su cuerpo.
es.omega-ruby: Su cuerpo está provisto de hojas afiladas. Cuando se desgastan, las afila con cantos rodados a la orilla del río.
es.alpha-sapphire: Ataca en grupo ignorando sus heridas y hundiendo en su presa las cuchillas que recubren su cuerpo.
es.ultra-sun: Tras rebanar a sus presas, afila sus cuchillas con piedras de río. Cada Pawniard tiene una piedra favorita.
es.ultra-moon: Acata las órdenes de Bisharp a pies juntillas. Cuando rebana a un oponente, hace sonar las cuchillas de sus brazos chocándolas entre sí.
es.sword: Acorrala a los enemigos con las cuchillas de su cuerpo, que afila usando cantos rodados a la orilla del río.
es.shield: Forman grupos encabezados por un Bisharp. Se entrenan a diario soñando con llegar a liderar el grupo algún día.

en.black: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
en.white: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
en.black-2: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
en.white-2: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
en.x: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
en.y: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
en.omega-ruby: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It then moves in to finish the prey off.
en.alpha-sapphire: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
en.ultra-sun: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it’s said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.
en.ultra-moon: It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn’t even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.
en.sword: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.
en.shield: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

es.x: Un Pokémon temible que remata a su presa una vez que su séquito de Pawniard la ha debilitado e inmovilizado.
es.y: Su séquito son los Pawniard. Acorralan a su presa con todo el grupo y Bisharp propina el golpe de gracia.
es.omega-ruby: Un Pokémon temible que remata a su presa una vez que su séquito de Pawniard la ha debilitado e inmovilizado.
es.alpha-sapphire: Su séquito son los Pawniard. Acorralan a su presa con todo el grupo y Bisharp propina el golpe de gracia.
es.ultra-sun: Por fuerte que sea un Bisharp, la más mínima mella en la hoja de su cabeza es deshonrosa y motivo de destitución como líder de su grupo.
es.ultra-moon: Lidera un grupo de Pawniard y no muestra el más mínimo sentimiento ni cuando propina el ataque de gracia al rival.
es.sword: Siempre va acompañado por un nutrido séquito de Pawniard, a los que no pierde nunca de vista para evitar posibles motines.
es.shield: Libra encarnizados combates con los Fraxure por el control de los emplazamientos donde se hallan las piedras con las que afila sus cuchillas.

en.black: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
en.white: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
en.black-2: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.
en.white-2: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.
en.x: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
en.y: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
en.omega-ruby: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.
en.alpha-sapphire: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
en.sword: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.
en.shield: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

es.x: Embiste con la cabeza sin distinción. Su potencia es capaz de hacer descarrilar un tren en marcha.
es.y: Aunque encaje un cabezazo violento, su pelaje absorbe el daño.
es.omega-ruby: Embiste con la cabeza sin distinción. Su potencia es capaz de hacer descarrilar un tren en marcha.
es.alpha-sapphire: Aunque encaje un cabezazo violento, su pelaje absorbe el daño.
es.sword: Puede destrozar un coche de un solo testarazo. Cuanto más abundante sea su melena, mayor rango tendrá en la jerarquía de la manada.
es.shield: Forman manadas de unos veinte individuos. Se desconoce el motivo, pero los que traicionan la confianza del grupo pierden la melena.

en.black: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
en.white: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
en.black-2: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.
en.white-2: It stands up to massive opponents, not out of courage, but out of recklessness. But that is how it gets stronger.
en.x: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
en.y: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
en.omega-ruby: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
en.alpha-sapphire: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.
en.sun: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.
en.moon: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.
en.ultra-sun: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.
en.ultra-moon: Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.
en.sword: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can’t resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.
en.shield: A combative Pokémon, it’s ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.
en.legends-arceus: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

es.x: Quiebra bayas con sus extremidades. Se enfrenta con valentía a todo enemigo por fuerte que este sea.
es.y: Desafía indiscriminadamente a rivales poderosos. Librar numerosas batallas lo hace fuerte.
es.omega-ruby: Quiebra bayas con sus extremidades. Se enfrenta con valentía a todo enemigo por fuerte que este sea.
es.alpha-sapphire: Desafía indiscriminadamente a rivales poderosos. Librar numerosas batallas lo hace fuerte.
es.sun: Desafía indiscriminadamente a cualquier rival. Cada vez que le hieren en combate o se debilita no hace sino aumentar su fortaleza.
es.moon: Es un Pokémon carnívoro, aunque no les hace ascos a las bayas. Clava con ahínco sus garras afiladas en la presa para picotearla sin cesar.
es.ultra-sun: La fuerza de los talones y dureza de las garras le permiten perforar la coraza de los Shellder para picotear su cuerpo.
es.ultra-moon: Su especie es guerrera y belicosa por naturaleza y lo primero que hacen nada más nacer es medir sus fuerzas contra sus progenitores.
es.sword: Cuando ve a un Pokémon de aspecto fuerte, no puede resistirse a desafiarlo en combate. Si pierde, llora y se lamenta a pleno pulmón.
es.shield: Es capaz de partir hasta la baya más dura gracias a la fuerza de sus extremidades. Belicoso por naturaleza, planta cara a cualquiera.

en.black: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
en.white: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
en.black-2: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
en.white-2: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
en.x: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
en.y: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
en.omega-ruby: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
en.alpha-sapphire: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
en.sun: With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as “the hero of the sky.”
en.moon: It’s thought that people disturbed their habitats in the past, so Braviary banded together to fight back.
en.ultra-sun: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it’s considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.
en.ultra-moon: Known as “the hero of the skies,” this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it’s injured.
en.sword: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokémon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.
en.shield: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it’s Corviknight that’s taken the role of transportation in Galar.
en.legends-arceus: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

es.x: Un valiente guerrero del cielo que no duda en luchar por sus compañeros por graves que sean sus heridas.
es.y: Lucha por sus compañeros sin reparar en el peligro. Es capaz de volar alto incluso con un coche en sus garras.
es.omega-ruby: Un valiente guerrero del cielo que no duda en luchar por sus compañeros por graves que sean sus heridas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Lucha por sus compañeros sin reparar en el peligro. Es capaz de volar alto incluso con un coche en sus garras.
es.sun: Por su talante aguerrido, no titubea a la hora de jugarse el pellejo. Los antiguos habitantes de Alola lo veneraban como el Héroe del Cielo.
es.moon: Cuando los seres humanos amenazaban su hábitat en el pasado, los Braviary se agrupaban para oponer resistencia.
es.ultra-sun: Las cicatrices que surcan su frente demuestran su valor, pero las de su espalda son motivo de mofa por parte de su bandada.
es.ultra-moon: Se le conoce como Héroe del Cielo, y su orgullo y valía son tales que prefiere salir herido antes que huir de forma deshonrosa.
es.sword: Un Pokémon osado y orgulloso, cuyo majestuoso porte lo convierte en un motivo heráldico muy popular.
es.shield: Su carácter agresivo e irascible le ha hecho perder su puesto como transportista en Galar en favor de los Corviknight.

en.black: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
en.white: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
en.black-2: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
en.white-2: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
en.x: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
en.y: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
en.omega-ruby: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
en.alpha-sapphire: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
en.sun: It protects its plump posterior with the bones of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it replaces the bones.
en.moon: It can’t fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it’s still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.
en.ultra-sun: Mandibuzz gives it the bones it wears. Vullaby’s wings are short, so it can’t fly yet, but it jumps around, dreaming of wide open skies.
en.ultra-moon: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
en.sword: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.
en.shield: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

es.x: No puede volar porque sus alas son muy pequeñas. Cuando va a evolucionar, se deshace de su calavera.
es.y: Sus pequeñas alas no le permiten volar. Usa una calavera que le dio Mandibuzz para proteger sus posaderas.
es.omega-ruby: No puede volar porque sus alas son muy pequeñas. Cuando va a evolucionar, se deshace de su calavera.
es.alpha-sapphire: Sus pequeñas alas no le permiten volar. Usa una calavera que le dio Mandibuzz para proteger sus posaderas.
es.sun: Protege sus posaderas blanduzcas con los huesos de las presas que ha devorado. A medida que crece se ve obligado a cambiarlos.
es.moon: Todavía está en su más tierna infancia. Como sus alas aún no se han desarrollado del todo, se desplaza dando saltos.
es.ultra-sun: El cráneo que usa de protección es regalo de un Mandibuzz. Como sus alas son muy cortas para volar, da brincos soñando que vuela por el cielo.
es.ultra-moon: Demuestra un voraz apetito y aumenta de tamaño a vista de ojo. Su continuo crecimiento le obliga a cambiar varias veces de cráneo.
es.sword: Usa una calavera para proteger sus posaderas. A menudo pelea con sus congéneres para hacerse con la más cómoda.
es.shield: Deja en el nido las calaveras que va descartando a medida que crece con celeridad para que las reutilicen futuras generaciones.

en.black: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
en.white: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
en.black-2: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
en.white-2: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
en.x: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
en.y: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
en.omega-ruby: They fly in circles around the sky. When they spot prey, they attack and carry it back to their nest with ease.
en.alpha-sapphire: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.
en.sun: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.
en.moon: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.
en.ultra-sun: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.
en.ultra-moon: It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.
en.sword: Although it’s a bit of a ruffian, this Pokémon will take lost Vullaby under its wing and care for them till they’re ready to leave the nest.
en.shield: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

es.x: Vuela en círculos. Cuando avista una presa, la ataca y la transporta a su nido con suma facilidad.
es.y: Otea la superficie desde el cielo y ataca a Pokémon debilitados. Tiene por costumbre hacerse adornos con huesos.
es.omega-ruby: Vuela en círculos. Cuando avista una presa, la ataca y la transporta a su nido con suma facilidad.
es.alpha-sapphire: Otea la superficie desde el cielo y ataca a Pokémon debilitados. Tiene por costumbre hacerse adornos con huesos.
es.sun: Se dice que los huesos con los que se engalana le sirven para cortejar al otro sexo, aunque nunca se ha avistado ningún Mandibuzz macho.
es.moon: Revolotea por el cielo en busca de un Pokémon débil al que convertir en su presa. Tiene una particular debilidad por los Cubone.
es.ultra-sun: Utiliza con pericia los huesos de las presas que devora para así construir un nido. La mayoría de los huesos pertenecen a los Cubone.
es.ultra-moon: Busca sin cesar comida para alimentar a Vullaby. Atrapa al instante a cualquier Pokémon debilitado que aviste y lo lleva al nido.
es.sword: A pesar de su carácter violento, si avista un Vullaby perdido, lo acoge en su nido y lo cuida con esmero hasta que está listo para partir.
es.shield: Se engalana con los huesos que va recogiendo. Al parecer, la elección no es casual, sino que obedece a los dictados de la moda.

en.black: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
en.white: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
en.black-2: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
en.white-2: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
en.x: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
en.y: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
en.omega-ruby: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant’s steel bodies and consume their insides.
en.alpha-sapphire: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
en.sword: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
en.shield: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

es.x: Usa su lengua de fuego para derretir la armadura de acero de los Durant y llegar así hasta su interior.
es.y: Absorbe aire por el orificio de su cola para prender una lengua de llamas con la que derrite a los Durant para comerlos.
es.omega-ruby: Usa su lengua de fuego para derretir la armadura de acero de los Durant y llegar así hasta su interior.
es.alpha-sapphire: Absorbe aire por el orificio de su cola para prender una lengua de llamas con la que derrite a los Durant para comerlos.
es.sword: Absorbe aire por el orificio de la cola para prender las llamas que expulsa. Si la abertura se obstruye, enferma.
es.shield: Usa llamas a modo de lengua para derretir el duro exoesqueleto de los Durant antes de devorarlos.

en.black: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
en.white: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.
en.black-2: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
en.white-2: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
en.x: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
en.y: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
en.omega-ruby: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.
en.alpha-sapphire: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
en.sword: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.
en.shield: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

es.x: Actúan en grupo para expulsar de sus colonias a los Heatmor, sus depredadores naturales.
es.y: Llevan una armadura de acero. Se defienden en grupo para contrarrestar a sus depredadores, los Heatmor.
es.omega-ruby: Actúan en grupo para expulsar de sus colonias a los Heatmor, sus depredadores naturales.
es.alpha-sapphire: Llevan una armadura de acero. Se defienden en grupo para contrarrestar a sus depredadores, los Heatmor.
es.sword: Deposita sus huevos en la parte más profunda del nido. Si un Heatmor lo ataca, se defiende mordiéndolo con sus enormes mandíbulas.
es.shield: Con sus grandes mandíbulas puede destrozar incluso rocas. Lucha en grupo para proteger sus larvas del ataque de los Sandaconda.

en.black: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
en.white: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
en.black-2: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
en.white-2: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
en.x: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
en.y: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
en.omega-ruby: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.
en.alpha-sapphire: Lacking sight, it’s unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
en.sword: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.
en.shield: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

es.x: No ve, por eso va haciendo placajes y dando mordiscos a diestro y siniestro. Su cuerpo está plagado de heridas.
es.y: No ve bien a su alrededor, por eso va chocándose a diestro y siniestro, y mordiendo todo lo que se mueve.
es.omega-ruby: No ve, por eso va haciendo placajes y dando mordiscos a diestro y siniestro. Su cuerpo está plagado de heridas.
es.alpha-sapphire: No ve bien a su alrededor, por eso va chocándose a diestro y siniestro, y mordiendo todo lo que se mueve.
es.sword: Muestra cierta tendencia a morder todo lo que encuentra. Se cree que recuerda perfectamente el olor de lo que encuentra delicioso.
es.shield: Al no poder ver, su forma de orientarse y percibir el entorno consiste en chocarse a diestro y siniestro, mordiendo todo lo que se encuentra.

en.black: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
en.white: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.
en.black-2: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
en.white-2: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
en.x: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
en.y: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
en.omega-ruby: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
en.alpha-sapphire: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
en.sword: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.
en.shield: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

es.x: Sus dos cabezas se llevan fatal, y la que consigue comer más que la otra es la que lleva la voz cantante.
es.y: Cambia de morada siempre que termina con la comida de una zona. Sus dos cabezas se llevan fatal.
es.omega-ruby: Sus dos cabezas se llevan fatal, y la que consigue comer más que la otra es la que lleva la voz cantante.
es.alpha-sapphire: Cambia de morada siempre que termina con la comida de una zona. Sus dos cabezas se llevan fatal.
es.sword: Rastrea su territorio en busca de alimento. A menudo sus dos cabezas son incapaces de acordar hacia qué dirección avanzar.
es.shield: Las dos cabezas se disputan la comida con brutalidad. Por eso siempre está cubierto de heridas, aunque no haya combatido contra nadie.

en.black: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
en.white: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
en.black-2: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
en.white-2: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
en.x: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
en.y: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
en.omega-ruby: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.
en.alpha-sapphire: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
en.sword: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.
en.shield: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

es.x: Las cabezas de sus dos brazos no tienen cerebro. Con sus tres cabezas destruye y devora todo a su paso.
es.y: Un Pokémon temible que ataca todo lo que se mueve y devora con sus tres cabezas cuanto halla a su paso.
es.omega-ruby: Las cabezas de sus dos brazos no tienen cerebro. Con sus tres cabezas destruye y devora todo a su paso.
es.alpha-sapphire: Un Pokémon temible que ataca todo lo que se mueve y devora con sus tres cabezas cuanto halla a su paso.
es.sword: Ataca y devora todo lo que se mueve. Existen numerosos relatos de pueblos enteros que fueron arrasados por este Pokémon.
es.shield: Sus tres cabezas se alternan para dar mordiscos y no cejarán en su ataque hasta que el rival haya caído redondo.

en.black: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
en.white: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
en.black-2: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
en.white-2: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
en.x: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
en.y: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
en.omega-ruby: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
en.alpha-sapphire: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.
en.ultra-sun: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
en.ultra-moon: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
en.sword: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.
en.shield: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

es.x: Se dice que nació del sol. Al evolucionar, cubre su cuerpo con llamas que brotan de sus cuernos.
es.y: Vive en las laderas de los volcanes. Emite fuego por sus cinco cuernos para ahuyentar a sus enemigos.
es.omega-ruby: Se dice que nació del sol. Al evolucionar, cubre su cuerpo con llamas que brotan de sus cuernos.
es.alpha-sapphire: Vive en las laderas de los volcanes. Emite fuego por sus cinco cuernos para ahuyentar a sus enemigos.
es.ultra-sun: Cuando ha de enfrentarse a un rival, expulsa a través de los cinco cuernos llamaradas que llegan a alcanzar temperaturas de 3000 ºC.
es.ultra-moon: Utiliza las llamas para defenderse. La gente de épocas pasadas tenía la creencia de que anidaba en el propio sol.
es.sword: Antaño se creía que este Pokémon provenía del mismísimo sol.
es.shield: Su cuerpo es cálido. Expulsa llamaradas por los cuernos con el fin de intimidar a sus enemigos y presas.

en.black: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
en.white: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
en.black-2: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.
en.white-2: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.
en.x: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
en.y: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
en.omega-ruby: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
en.alpha-sapphire: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
en.ultra-sun: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”
en.ultra-moon: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
en.sword: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.
en.shield: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

es.x: Cuando combate, despide escamas ardientes de sus seis alas y genera un mar ígneo a su alrededor.
es.y: Antaño, las cenizas volcánicas cubrieron los cielos. Entonces, sus llamaradas sirvieron de sol.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando combate, despide escamas ardientes de sus seis alas y genera un mar ígneo a su alrededor.
es.alpha-sapphire: Antaño, las cenizas volcánicas cubrieron los cielos. Entonces, sus llamaradas sirvieron de sol.
es.ultra-sun: Esparce escamas flamígeras a medida que surca el cielo. Era temido por la gente de tiempo ha, que lo apodaron la Ira del Sol.
es.ultra-moon: Una leyenda relata cómo nació de un capullo en llamas para acudir al rescate de humanos y Pokémon ateridos por el frío.
es.sword: Se dice que sus escamas flamígeras pueden tanto causar incendios como amparar a aquellos que sufren las inclemencias del frío.
es.shield: Nace de una pupa envuelta en llamas. En algunas pinturas rupestres aparece representado como una deidad del fuego.

en.black: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
en.white: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
en.black-2: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
en.white-2: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
en.x: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
en.y: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
en.omega-ruby: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
en.alpha-sapphire: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
en.sword: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.

es.x: Usa sus grandes orejas para excavar en la tierra y así crear madrigueras. Puede pasarse una noche entera cavando sin parar.
es.y: Tiene unas orejas tan grandes que parecen palas. Las ha fortalecido tanto usándolas para excavar que son capaces de arrancar raíces bien gruesas.

es.sword: Usa hábilmente las orejas para hacer hoyos. Es capaz de excavar una madriguera a 10 m bajo tierra en una sola noche.
es.shield: Está en alerta permanente. En cuanto oye el batir de alas de un Corviknight, cava un agujero y se oculta bajo tierra.

en.x: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
en.y: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
en.omega-ruby: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
en.alpha-sapphire: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
en.sword: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
en.shield: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

es.x: Sus grandes orejas tienen tal fuerza que con ellas puede levantar con facilidad rocas de más de una tonelada. Es de una ayuda inestimable en las obras.
es.y: Sus orejas, tan poderosas como una excavadora, pueden hacer añicos hasta la roca más sólida. Cuando termina de cavar, se toma un respiro.
es.omega-ruby: Sus grandes orejas tienen tal fuerza que con ellas puede levantar con facilidad rocas de más de una tonelada. Es de una ayuda inestimable en las obras.

es.shield: El pelaje de su abdomen es un aislante térmico excelente, tanto que antaño se usaba el que mudaba para confeccionar prendas de abrigo.

en.x: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
en.y: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it’s finished digging, it lounges lazily.
en.omega-ruby: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
en.alpha-sapphire: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it’s finished digging, it lounges lazily.
en.sword: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It’s a huge help during tunnel construction.
en.shield: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

es.x: Es muy amigable y se comunica con sus aliados mediante melodiosos gorjeos y el movimiento de su cola y sus gráciles alas.
es.y: Su melodioso gorjeo lo dota de una gran belleza, pero adopta una actitud agresiva y despiadada hacia cualquiera que ose invadir su territorio.
es.omega-ruby: Es muy amigable y se comunica con sus aliados mediante melodiosos gorjeos y el movimiento de su cola y sus gráciles alas.
es.alpha-sapphire: Su melodioso gorjeo lo dota de una gran belleza, pero adopta una actitud agresiva y despiadada hacia cualquiera que ose invadir su territorio.
es.sun: Su carácter amigable lo convierte en un Pokémon muy dócil. Ahora bien, en cuanto se pone a combatir, se vuelve un adversario implacable.
es.moon: Cuando se exalta, su temperatura corporal llega a duplicarse y sus hormonas se descontrolan.
es.ultra-sun: Es de carácter afable, pero si lo tocan en contra de su voluntad, aumenta repentinamente su temperatura y puede provocar quemaduras.
es.ultra-moon: Su cuerpo emana bastante calor, razón por la que los Entrenadores de regiones frías les permiten dormir en sus camas.
es.sword: Sus melodiosos gorjeos son en realidad un aviso. Acribilla a picotazos a todo el que ose invadir su territorio.
es.shield: Su temperatura corporal aumenta de repente cuando se exalta y puede causar quemaduras al contacto con la piel.

en.x: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
en.y: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.
en.omega-ruby: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
en.alpha-sapphire: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s merciless to intruders that enter its territory.
en.sun: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.
en.moon: When it’s excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.
en.ultra-sun: While it’s an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you’ll be burned.
en.ultra-moon: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.
en.sword: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.
en.shield: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

es.x: Lanza chispas por su pico y prende fuego a la hierba alta para así sorprender a sus presas y atraparlas cuando intentan escapar.
es.y: Cuanto más intenso sea el calor que se genera en la saca de fuego de su vientre, más rápido es capaz de volar. Sin embargo, la llama tarda en prender.
es.omega-ruby: Lanza chispas por su pico y prende fuego a la hierba alta para así sorprender a sus presas y atraparlas cuando intentan escapar.
es.alpha-sapphire: Cuanto más intenso sea el calor que se genera en la saca de fuego de su vientre, más rápido es capaz de volar. Sin embargo, la llama tarda en prender.
es.sun: Lanza chispas por el pico para atacar a su presa, a la que devora una vez calcinada.
es.moon: No tolera bajo ningún concepto que otro Fletchinder invada su territorio, cuyo radio abarca varios kilómetros.
es.ultra-sun: Prende fuego a los arbustos con las chispas que suelta y aprovecha para cazar los Pokémon Bicho que salen corriendo despavoridos.
es.ultra-moon: La velocidad que alcanza nada más emprender el vuelo es de las más altas de entre todos los Pokémon pájaro.
es.sword: Lanza chispas al interior de la guarida de su presa y, cuando esta sale despavorida, la ataca por sorpresa con sus afiladas garras.
es.shield: Defienden su territorio con suma agresividad. Se pelean entre sí por el control de las áreas de caza.

en.x: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
en.y: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
en.omega-ruby: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
en.alpha-sapphire: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
en.sun: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.
en.moon: It will not tolerate other Fletchinder entering its territory, which has a radius of several miles.
en.ultra-sun: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.
en.ultra-moon: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
en.sword: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.
en.shield: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

es.x: Si se exalta durante un combate reñido, arroja chispas y ascuas de los intersticios entre su plumaje mientras vuela.
es.y: Llega a alcanzar los 500 km/h al perseguir a su presa, a quien le asesta el golpe de gracia con una patada muy potente.
es.omega-ruby: Si se exalta durante un combate reñido, arroja chispas y ascuas de los intersticios entre su plumaje mientras vuela.

es.sun: Wingull y Pikipek son sus presas favoritas. Les asesta un potente golpe y después las atrapa sin remisión con sus garras afiladas.
es.moon: Se abalanza en línea recta sobre su presa a una velocidad de 500 km/h mientras arroja chispas y ascuas de los intersticios entre su plumaje.
es.ultra-sun: Sus alas son resistentes al fuego, por lo que se solían usar sus plumas para confeccionar trajes de bombero.
es.ultra-moon: Su presa favorita son los Pokémon pájaro, a los cuales se acerca a velocidades vertiginosas y derriba con la temible potencia de sus patas.
es.sword: Su presa predilecta son los Pokémon pájaro. Intimida a sus rivales lanzando ascuas desde los intersticios de su plumaje.
es.shield: Arremete contra sus presas a una velocidad de 500 km/h y les asesta el golpe de gracia con una patada muy potente, sin dejarles escapatoria.

en.x: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
en.y: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
en.omega-ruby: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
en.alpha-sapphire: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
en.sun: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.
en.moon: It zooms directly at its prey at flight speeds of close to 310 mph, while fiery embers scatter from gaps in its feathers.
en.ultra-sun: Its tough wings don’t allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters’ outfits were made from Talonflame wings.
en.ultra-moon: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.
en.sword: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.
en.shield: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

es.x: Cuando recibe el ataque de un Pokémon pájaro, expulsa unas escamas negras que provocan parálisis si se entra en contacto con ellas.
es.y: Gracias al polvo de escamas que lo recubre y regula su temperatura, puede vivir en cualquier región, sin importar las características del terreno o el clima.

es.x: Cuanto más poderoso es el enemigo al que se enfrenta, más calor desprende su mechón y más energía recorre todo su cuerpo.
es.y: Se separa de su manada para hacerse más fuerte y aprender a valerse por sí mismo. Su excesiva fogosidad le hace saltar a la mínima.
es.omega-ruby: Cuanto más poderoso es el enemigo al que se enfrenta, más calor desprende su mechón y más energía recorre todo su cuerpo.

es.ultra-sun: Mientras es solo una cría vive con el resto de la manada, pero en cuanto aprende a cazar se separa del grupo y se independiza.
es.ultra-moon: Este enérgico Pokémon es de naturaleza curiosa e inquieta y, tanto al comienzo de un combate como cuando se enoja, su crin prende fuego.

en.x: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
en.y: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.
en.omega-ruby: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

en.ultra-sun: When they’re young, they live with a pride. Once they’re able to hunt prey on their own, they’re kicked out and have to make their own way.
en.ultra-moon: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

es.x: El macho con la melena de fuego más grande de toda la manada es el líder de sus compañeros.
es.y: Intimida con ferocidad al enemigo exhalando su aliento abrasador a 6000 °C de temperatura. Las hembras protegen a los cachorros de la manada.
es.omega-ruby: El macho con la melena de fuego más grande de toda la manada es el líder de sus compañeros.

es.ultra-sun: Por lo general, el macho suele ser un holgazán, pero si aparece un enemigo poderoso, no duda en plantarle cara para proteger a los suyos.
es.ultra-moon: Su aliento alcanza temperaturas de 6000 ºC, aunque no lo emplea contra sus presas, ya que prefiere la carne más bien cruda.

en.x: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
en.y: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride’s cubs.
en.omega-ruby: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
en.alpha-sapphire: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride’s cubs.
en.ultra-sun: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
en.ultra-moon: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

es.x: Puede controlar el poder oculto de las flores. La flor que lleva consigo es como si formara parte de su cuerpo.
es.y: En cuanto encuentra una flor de su agrado, la convierte en su hogar para toda la vida. Flota en el aire a su antojo cabalgando el viento.
es.omega-ruby: Puede controlar el poder oculto de las flores. La flor que lleva consigo es como si formara parte de su cuerpo.

es.ultra-moon: Acumula el polen de las flores para confeccionar la tiara que lleva en la cabeza, que cuenta con propiedades curativas.

en.x: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
en.y: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind’s embrace with an untroubled heart.
en.omega-ruby: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

en.ultra-sun: It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
en.ultra-moon: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

es.x: Revolotea alrededor de campos de flores y cuida de aquellas que empiezan a marchitarse. Usa en combate el poder oculto de las flores.
es.y: Cuando las plantas bien cuidadas de un parterre florecen, hace acto de presencia e interpreta un baile primoroso para celebrarlo.
es.omega-ruby: Revolotea alrededor de campos de flores y cuida de aquellas que empiezan a marchitarse. Usa en combate el poder oculto de las flores.

es.ultra-sun: Usa como arma la flor que cultiva por su cuenta y, cuanto mayor sea la belleza de esta, mayor será también el poder que oculta en su interior.
es.ultra-moon: Confiere su poder a las flores y cuida de ellas con mucho esmero; no perdona que destruyan los campos donde estas crecen.

en.x: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
en.y: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
en.omega-ruby: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
en.alpha-sapphire: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
en.ultra-sun: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
en.ultra-moon: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

es.x: Habita en preciosos jardines floridos. Absorbe la energía que emiten las plantas y la convierte en su fuente de poder.
es.y: Los propietarios de los castillos de antaño solían invitar a Florges para que creasen jardines floridos, a fin de decorar sus terrenos.

es.ultra-sun: Es capaz de controlar las flores que cultiva. La ráfaga de pétalos que emplea es hermosa a la vez que devastadora.
es.ultra-moon: Su esperanza de vida asciende a varios siglos y dedica toda su dilatada existencia al cuidado de los jardines.

en.ultra-moon: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

en.omega-ruby: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
en.alpha-sapphire: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

es.x: Se esfuerza mucho para que el enemigo no lo menosprecie, pero su mirada no intimida demasiado. Se caracteriza por mascar siempre una hoja.
es.y: Se desvive tratando de fulminar a su rival con una mirada aterradora, pero en cuanto le acarician la cabeza, no puede evitar sonreír de oreja a oreja.
es.omega-ruby: Se esfuerza mucho para que el enemigo no lo menosprecie, pero su mirada no intimida demasiado. Se caracteriza por mascar siempre una hoja.
es.alpha-sapphire: Se desvive tratando de fulminar a su rival con una mirada aterradora, pero en cuanto le acarician la cabeza, no puede evitar sonreír de oreja a oreja.
es.sun: En su afán por madurar, toma como modelo a Pangoro, hacia el que profesa sumo respeto. Para él es como una especie de mentor.
es.moon: Solo masca la hoja que lleva porque le gusta el aire que le confiere. Su carácter pícaro lo hace incompatible con los Entrenadores novatos.
es.ultra-sun: Sigue los pasos de Pangoro, a quien considera su maestro. En caso de cometer un grave error, este le arrebata la hierba de la boca.
es.ultra-moon: Intenta amedrentar a su oponente a toda costa. Si fija la mirada en alguien, solo hay que aparentar tener miedo para hacerlo feliz.
es.sword: Sigue los pasos de Pangoro, a quien considera su mentor. A base de imitarlo, aprende a combatir y a cazar presas.
es.shield: Siempre lanza una mirada fulminante al rival para que no lo menosprecie, pero en cuanto se relaja esboza sin querer una sonrisa.

en.x: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
en.y: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.
en.omega-ruby: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
en.alpha-sapphire: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.
en.sun: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
en.moon: There’s no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It’s mischievous, so it’s not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.
en.ultra-sun: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.
en.ultra-moon: It’s desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.
en.sword: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master’s actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.
en.shield: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

en.moon: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent’s movements. It’s eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.
en.x: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
en.y: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.
en.omega-ruby: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
en.alpha-sapphire: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.
en.sun: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro’s Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.
en.ultra-sun: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.
en.ultra-moon: Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn’t say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.
en.sword: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.
en.shield: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

es.x: Es muy temperamental, pero no permite que nadie se meta con los débiles. Mediante su hoja, predice los movimientos del enemigo.
es.y: No se arredra ante los ataques y embiste con una fuerza tan abrumadora que sería capaz de derribar un robusto poste telefónico de hormigón.
es.omega-ruby: Es muy temperamental, pero no permite que nadie se meta con los débiles. Mediante su hoja, predice los movimientos del enemigo.
es.alpha-sapphire: No se arredra ante los ataques y embiste con una fuerza tan abrumadora que sería capaz de derribar un robusto poste telefónico de hormigón.
es.sun: Su aspecto imponente rinde justicia a la fuerza de la que hace gala. Todo aspirante a entrenarlo deberá entender el lenguaje de los puños.
es.moon: Predice los movimientos del enemigo mediante su hoja. Pese a su carácter temperamental, se muestra muy afable con sus compañeros.
es.ultra-sun: Pokémon un tanto agresivo que se jacta de la fuerza de sus puños. A muchos Entrenadores les llama la atención su carácter atrevido.
es.ultra-moon: Prefiere solucionar las disputas a mamporros. Puede embestir un camión y hacerlo volar por los aires a largas distancias sin despeinarse.
es.sword: Este Pokémon de carácter agresivo lo soluciona todo a golpes. Desata su espíritu combativo al enfrentarse a los Obstagoon.
es.shield: La hoja que lleva en la boca le permite predecir los movimientos del rival. Puede reducir un camión a chatarra de un solo puñetazo.

es.x: Cuando le esquilan su mullido pelaje, no solo mejora su apariencia, sino que aumenta su agilidad.
es.y: Antiguamente, estos Pokémon desempeñaban el cometido de guardián del rey en la región de Kalos.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando le esquilan su mullido pelaje, no solo mejora su apariencia, sino que aumenta su agilidad.
es.alpha-sapphire: Antiguamente, estos Pokémon desempeñaban el cometido de guardián del rey en la región de Kalos.
es.ultra-sun: Hubo una época en la que los aristócratas competían entre ellos procurando que el corte de pelo de su Furfrou fuera el mejor de todos.
es.ultra-moon: El pelo le crece sin cesar, pero solo deja que se lo corten aquellos de quienes se fía plenamente.

en.x: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
en.y: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
en.omega-ruby: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
en.alpha-sapphire: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
en.ultra-sun: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou’s fur into the most exquisite style.
en.ultra-moon: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

es.x: Protege con las orejas el órgano con el que irradia su intenso poder psíquico para evitar que este se escape al exterior.
es.y: Posee poderes psíquicos suficientes para lanzar por los aires objetos situados en un radio de 100 metros, pero carece de pericia para controlarlos.
es.omega-ruby: Protege con las orejas el órgano con el que irradia su intenso poder psíquico para evitar que este se escape al exterior.
es.alpha-sapphire: Posee poderes psíquicos suficientes para lanzar por los aires objetos situados en un radio de 100 metros, pero carece de pericia para controlarlos.
es.sword: Su inexpresividad aparente esconde una lucha titánica por contener su inmenso poder psíquico.
es.shield: Es capaz de mandar por los aires a un luchador profesional gracias a sus poderes psíquicos, pero tiene serios problemas para controlarlos.

en.x: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
en.y: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.
en.omega-ruby: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
en.alpha-sapphire: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.
en.sword: Though Espurr’s expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.
en.shield: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

es.x: Cuando percibe peligro, yergue sus orejas y desata un poder psíquico capaz de levantar un camión de unas 10 toneladas.
es.y: Las marcas en forma de ojos que tiene en las orejas emiten poderes psíquicos, pero su potencia es tan avasalladora que las mantiene tapadas.
es.omega-ruby: Cuando percibe peligro, yergue sus orejas y desata un poder psíquico capaz de levantar un camión de unas 10 toneladas.

es.sword: Emite sus poderes psíquicos por las marcas en forma de ojos que tiene en las orejas, aunque, por lo general, las mantiene ocultas.
es.shield: El fuerte instinto protector de los machos los lleva a liberar todo su poder cuando se trata de defenderse a sí mismos o a su Entrenador.

en.x: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
en.y: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.
en.omega-ruby: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
en.alpha-sapphire: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.
en.sword: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.
en.shield: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

es.x: Cuentan que este Pokémon nace cuando el espíritu de un difunto toma posesión de una espada antigua. Se aferra a las personas y absorbe su energía.
es.y: Si alguien osa empuñarlo, se enrolla en el brazo del desafortunado con su paño azul y le absorbe toda la energía hasta que pierde el sentido.
es.omega-ruby: Cuentan que este Pokémon nace cuando el espíritu de un difunto toma posesión de una espada antigua. Se aferra a las personas y absorbe su energía.
es.alpha-sapphire: Si alguien osa empuñarlo, se enrolla en el brazo del desafortunado con su paño azul y le absorbe toda la energía hasta que pierde el sentido.
es.sword: Su alma es la de un ser humano que poseyó la misma espada que lo abatió en tiempos remotos.
es.shield: El ojo azul de la empuñadura es su verdadero cuerpo. Absorbe la energía vital de las personas con su paño de aspecto andrajoso.

en.x: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
en.y: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.
en.omega-ruby: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
en.alpha-sapphire: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.
en.sword: Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge’s body.
en.shield: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

es.x: Al evolucionar se divide en dos espadas. Se comunican entre sí mediante telepatía y coordinan los ataques para rebanar al enemigo.
es.y: Ni siquiera el espadachín más ducho conseguiría esquivar los complejos ataques que encadenan ambas espadas a la vez.
es.omega-ruby: Al evolucionar se divide en dos espadas. Se comunican entre sí mediante telepatía y coordinan los ataques para rebanar al enemigo.
es.alpha-sapphire: Ni siquiera el espadachín más ducho conseguiría esquivar los complejos ataques que encadenan ambas espadas a la vez.
es.sword: Su espada se duplicó durante su proceso de evolución. Intimida a los rivales con el chirrido metálico que produce al frotar ambas hojas.
es.shield: Su táctica para abatir a las presas consiste en alternar ataque y defensa de forma frenética entre ambas espadas.

en.x: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
en.y: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
en.omega-ruby: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
en.alpha-sapphire: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
en.sword: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.
en.shield: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

es.x: Han permanecido junto a estirpes de reyes durante generaciones. Mediante su poder espectral pueden controlar a humanos y a Pokémon.
es.y: Al parecer, puede intuir si un humano tiene madera de rey. Según se dice, las personas que obtuvieron su reconocimiento acabaron siendo reyes.

es.sword: Gracias a su cuerpo de acero y a una barrera de poder espectral, crea una defensa que le permite mitigar prácticamente cualquier ataque.
es.shield: Mediante el control ejercido con su inmenso poder espectral, logró que humanos y Pokémon le forjaran un país a medida de sus necesidades.

en.x: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
en.y: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
en.omega-ruby: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
en.alpha-sapphire: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
en.sword: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.
en.shield: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

es.x: Su cuerpo emana una fragancia que embelesa a quien la huele. La fragancia es diferente según los alimentos que ingiere.
es.y: Antaño, las damas de la nobleza llevaban un Spritzee consigo que desprendía su aroma preferido, en vez de utilizar un perfume convencional.
